Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

body schema loco-manipulation imitation learning vision-action interface kinematic tree

简要说明：BSP通过将身体图式归纳偏置引入视觉-动作接口，利用运动学树结构的潜在令牌和身体查询视觉，以远少于基础模型的参数实现高效全身移动操作，并加快动作推理速度。

TLDR: BSP introduces a body schema inductive bias into the vision-action interface, using kinematic-tree-structured latent tokens and body-queried vision to achieve efficient whole-body loco-manipulation with far fewer parameters and faster action inference than existing foundation models.

Abstract: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $Ψ_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.

摘要（中文）：目前，机器人能够通过规模化的方式学习全身操作与移动（loco-manipulation）：最强的策略模型拥有数十亿参数，却仍需针对具体任务进行微调。人类处理能力有限，却能通过一种身体图式（body schema）高效地学习和行动，这种图式组织着他们的所见与所为。我们提出身体图式策略（Body Schema Policy, BSP），一种将这种图式嵌入视觉-动作接口的模仿学习策略。其潜在的身体图式将关节标记（joint tokens）和连杆标记（link tokens）置于机器人的运动学树（kinematic tree）上，通过学习到的螺旋运动（screw motions）在连杆之间传递特征。通过身体查询式视觉（body-queried vision），每个身体部位获取各自的视觉证据，该证据用于条件化其动作去噪过程。凭借这一归纳偏置，BSP生成动作块（action chunk）的速度快于我们所比较的任何策略。紧凑且针对身体部位的视觉读出特征无需空间监督即可自发涌现：操作指令强烈依赖任务对象，而移动指令则更广泛地响应场景信息。在九项模拟Unitree G1全身任务中，BSP以少75倍的参数达到$Ψ_0$人形基础模型的性能，并将Diffusion Policy的成功率提高了近一倍。在真实的G1和Fetch移动操作臂上，同样验证了这一结果。

Authors: Lechen Zhang, Chenyuan Chen, Muxin Zhou, Zewen He, Yoshihiko Nakamura

Making the World React Realistically: A Closed-Loop Interactive World Model for Autonomous Driving WorldModel

closed-loop world model multi-agent reinforcement learning 3D Gaussian splatting behavioral realism autonomous driving simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的闭环交互世界模型，将行为建模与视觉渲染相结合，通过多智能体强化学习微调背景车辆策略，并对3D车辆资产进行逐高斯诊断，在长尾场景中显著提高了行为真实性和视觉保真度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a closed-loop interactive world model for autonomous driving that couples behavior modeling and visual rendering, using multi-agent reinforcement learning to fine-tune background-vehicle policies and per-Gaussian diagnosis for 3D vehicle assets, significantly improving behavioral realism and visual fidelity in long-tail scenarios.

Abstract: World models (WMs) generate driving scenarios beyond recorded logs, enabling the training and evaluation of autonomous driving systems in unseen interactions. However, existing WMs struggle to ensure both behavioral realism and visual fidelity, since they overlook the relationship between vehicle interactions and the ego visual observations. We propose a closed-loop interactive WM that couples behavior modeling and visual rendering. First, imitation-learned background-vehicle (BV) policies are fine-tuned with multi-agent reinforcement learning in the closed loop against an end-to-end ego planner that reacts to the rendered images, so that their interaction behaviors match those in real logs. Second, the viewpoints exposed by these interactions guide a per-Gaussian diagnosis of each 3D Gaussian vehicle asset, which attenuates view-dependent colors on under-observed Gaussians and fills never-observed surfaces with generated Gaussians, while preserving the observed appearance. Third, signal lights are rendered according to the driving intentions of the vehicles, by an editor that learns the light states unobserved for a vehicle through counterfactual fine-tuning with a light-state classifier. On long-tail closed-loop scenarios, our method reduces the divergence from real-world interaction behaviors by 85% and improves novel-view vehicle PSNR by 2.0dB over the state-of-the-art WM. The significance of BV light signaling in WMs is shown, as the rendered signal lights conveying BV driving intentions indirectly impact ego driving behaviors in a quarter of the scenarios.

摘要（中文）：世界模型（WMs）能够生成超越记录日志的驾驶场景，使得自动驾驶系统能够在未见交互中进行训练和评估。然而，现有世界模型难以同时确保行为真实性与视觉保真度，因为它们忽视了车辆交互与自我视觉观测之间的关系。我们提出了一种闭环交互式世界模型，将行为建模与视觉渲染相结合。首先，通过模仿学习得到的背景车辆（BV）策略，在闭环中与一个对渲染图像作出反应的自车端到端规划器进行多智能体强化学习微调，从而使其交互行为与真实日志中的行为相匹配。其次，这些交互所暴露的视角指导了对每个三维高斯车辆资产的逐高斯诊断，该诊断会衰减观测不足的高斯上的视角相关颜色，并用生成的高斯填补从未被观测到的表面，同时保留已观测到的外观。第三，信号灯根据车辆的驾驶意图进行渲染，通过一个编辑器实现，该编辑器利用反事实微调和信号灯状态分类器，学习车辆未观测到的信号灯状态。在长尾闭环场景中，我们的方法将真实世界交互行为的偏差降低了85%，并在新视角车辆PSNR上较最先进的世界模型提升了2.0dB。研究还显示了BV信号灯在世界模型中的重要性，因为渲染出的传达BV驾驶意图的信号灯在四分之一场景中间接影响了自车的驾驶行为。

Authors: Jia Hu, Yang Chang, Panqu Wang, Zhijun Fu, Chang Liu, Changjian Yu, Jintao Lai

Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration HumanoidEmbodied

multi-humanoid collaboration decentralized control vision-language planner loco-manipulation leader-follower coordination

简要说明：Heave-Ho 提出了一种去中心化的多仿人机协作框架，通过多智能体后训练、视觉语言规划器和基于语音的协调机制，实现了多达十个机器人的长时程运动操作任务，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: Heave-Ho introduces a decentralized framework for multi-humanoid collaboration, combining a multi-agent post-training method, a vision-language planner, and speech-based coordination to enable long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks with teams of up to ten robots, validated in simulation and on real robots.

Abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

摘要（中文）：协作有望将人形机器人的能力拓展至单个机器人无法企及的范畴。然而，实现这一潜力需要协调全身交互、连贯的长期规划以及多机器人之间的精确同步。我们提出Heave-Ho，一个面向长时程多人体机器人协同操作的去中心化框架。在低层，我们开发了一种多智能体后训练框架，将人形机器人基础跟踪模型适配至人体机器人之间的物理耦合交互，仅凭局部观测即可实现协调的去中心化控制。在高层，我们训练了一个视觉-语言规划器，并设计了一种基于语音的领导者-跟随者协调机制，以在无网络通信的情况下同步去中心化执行。该系统以两个相同的人形机器人训练，可扩展至多达十个机器人的团队，并在无需重新训练的条件下泛化至异构团队。为对这些能力进行基准测试，我们引入了HH-Bench，包含12项任务，涉及2至10个人形机器人团队，包括异构团队。系统评估表明，Heave-Ho在各项任务中持续优于基线方法，而真实世界实验则展示了其在挑战性任务中的稳健去中心化协作能力。

Authors: Ting-Hsuan Chen, Siheng Zhao, Han Jiang, Qi Pan, Louison Lu, Jiaheng Luo, Henghui Bao, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Yue Wang

HandUMI: A Modular Hand-Worn Parallel-Jaw Interface for Robot-Free Bimanual Data Capture Manipulation

bimanual demonstration robot-free data capture parallel-jaw gripper retargeting bimanual manipulation

简要说明：HandUMI 是一种开源、佩戴在手上的平行夹爪接口，用于免机器人的双手数据采集，具有可更换指尖和编码器孔径追踪，可重定向到多种机械臂，并已在真实双臂叠毛巾任务中通过 ACT 和 pi0 策略验证。

TLDR: HandUMI is an open-source, hand-worn parallel-jaw interface for collecting robot-free bimanual demonstrations, with swappable fingertips and encoder-based aperture tracking, which are retargeted to multiple robot arms and validated on real bimanual towel folding with ACT and pi0 policies.

Abstract: HandUMI captures robot-free bimanual demonstrations with a hand-worn parallel-jaw interface. Swappable fingertips match the robot's installed gripper; Quest/PICO controllers track hands and encoders measure aperture. Robot-agnostic recordings are retargeted by inverse kinematics to seven simulated bimanual arms (median position error $\leq 1.2$ mm; $\leq 4.7$% of episodes rejected). On bimanual towel folding, 562 robot-free demonstrations train policies on real PiPER arms: ACT succeeds in 12/20 attempts and fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ in 7/20; ACT on the first 101 and base $π_{0.5}$ each succeed in 0/20. Hardware and software are open source (Apache-2.0), and a pair costs USD 557 with Quest 3S, excluding the optional ZED Mini and host computer. Project website: https://murobotics.ai/research/handumi.

摘要（中文）：摘要：HandUMI通过一种手戴式平行夹爪界面实现无机器人双手演示采集。可更换指尖与机器人安装的夹爪相匹配；Quest/PICO控制器追踪手部运动，编码器测量开合度。与机器人无关的记录通过逆运动学重定向至七个仿真双臂（中位位置误差$\leq 1.2$毫米；$\leq 4.7$%的回合被剔除）。在双臂毛巾折叠任务中，562次无机器人演示训练真实PiPER手臂上的策略：ACT在20次尝试中成功12次，微调后的$π_{0.5}$在20次中成功7次；使用前101次演示训练的ACT和基础$π_{0.5}$均在20次尝试中成功0次。硬件和软件均为开源（Apache-2.0），一套设备搭配Quest 3S成本为557美元，不含可选的ZED Mini和主机。项目网站：https://murobotics.ai/research/handumi。

Authors: Brik Meza, Leonardo Perez, Alvaro Mendoza-Li, Aniela Ubillus, Mitshell Ramos, Raul Bastidas, Mauricio Olivera, Bryan Bastidas

AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving AutonomousDriving

streaming world-action model autoregressive temporal modeling causal video backbone future conditioning reinforcement learning

简要说明：AR-WAM提出了一种高效的流式世界动作模型，用于自动驾驶，通过因果视频骨干实现增量视觉上下文和单次前向未来条件化，在NAVSIM-v1上取得了最先进的PDMS，并在连续驾驶中优于基线。

TLDR: AR-WAM introduces an efficient streaming world-action model for autonomous driving that uses a causal video backbone for incremental visual context and single-pass future conditioning, achieving state-of-the-art PDMS on NAVSIM-v1 and outperforming baselines in continuous driving.

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models. In a dynamic setting of continuous driving, supervised AR-WAM keeps its visual history across decisions and outperforms strong world-action baselines.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶需要在快速响应新观察的同时预测交通的发展趋势。视频基础模型具备前一种能力，但反复的历史信息编码和迭代式视频生成使其在驾驶场景中应用成本高昂。我们提出AR-WAM，一种高效的流式世界-动作模型，将自回归时间建模与单次前向未来条件化相结合。由于其视频骨干网络是因果性的，AR-WAM能够增量更新视觉上下文，复用过去的计算结果，并根据观测到的运动状态对未来预测进行条件化。我们进一步假设，从近期观测中提取的未来特征可以在无需迭代视频生成的情况下提升动态交通场景中的泛化能力。因此，AR-WAM通过一次前向传播获取这些特征，并利用它们对轨迹生成进行条件化，随后通过强化学习直接优化驾驶奖励来改进策略。仅使用单个前置摄像头，AR-WAM在NAVSIM-v1上经过监督训练后达到91.5 PDMS，经过强化学习后达到94.0 PDMS，超越了所对比的强基线端到端世界-动作模型。在连续驾驶的动态场景中，监督训练的AR-WAM在多次决策间保持视觉历史，并优于强世界-动作基线模型。

Authors: Baiting Luo, Shatadal Mishra, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Nejib Ammar

ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters VLA

552B parameters sample efficiency generalization precise manipulation action DiT

简要说明：ScaleVLA将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展到5520亿参数，证明前沿规模的VLM骨干显著提升了机器人学习的样本效率、泛化能力和精确操作能力。

TLDR: ScaleVLA scales Vision-Language-Action models to 552B parameters, demonstrating that frontier-scale VLM backbones significantly improve sample efficiency, generalization, and precise manipulation in robot learning.

Abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

摘要（中文）：前沿视觉-语言模型（VLMs）如GPT-6 Astra在机器人控制中展现出卓越能力，表明大规模预训练能为物理动作提供有价值的知识。然而，大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仍依赖规模小得多的VLM主干，这一潜力在很大程度上未被充分利用。我们探究前沿规模的表征能否为机器人学习提供更坚实的基础。我们引入ScaleVLA，将552B的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash主干与可训练的动作DiT相连接，并在统一的训练设置下系统比较了从2B到552B的各类VLM。我们评估了机器人基础模型的三种基本能力。在样本效率方面，仅10条演示的性能就超过了使用50条演示训练的2B主干（87.8%对比85.6%）。在泛化能力方面，LIBERO-PRO的成功率达到45.1%，而较小主干最高仅为31.3%。在精准操作方面，真实场景中的充电器插入成功率从4/10提升至9/10，增益主要集中在接触敏感的对准环节。尽管规模庞大，ScaleVLA仍实现了每个动作块216毫秒的中位延迟。我们的研究结果表明，前沿VLM不仅可以作为推理智能体，还可以作为高效、可泛化的机器人策略的强大表征基础。

Authors: Ruixi Yu, Dairu Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, Zekai Li, Zhuo Cao, Luyang Niu, Yingsheng Zhang, Sikai Liang, Ke Fan, He Wang, Li Yi

Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning WorldModel

action-conditioned world models planning certificate-guided decision quality regret

简要说明：本文提出了CURE，一种基于证书引导的技术，用于评估行动条件世界模型是否可信任用于规划，并决定是去偏数据、增加采样还是探索。结果表明，关注决策质量而非视频感知质量，在模拟物理、MuJoCo和Language-Table等领域中降低了遗憾值。

TLDR: This paper introduces CURE, a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether action-conditioned world models can be trusted for planning, and determines whether to debias data, roll out more samples, or explore. It demonstrates that focusing on decision quality rather than video perceptual quality reduces regret across simulated physics, MuJoCo, and Language-Table domains.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions. By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

摘要（中文）：动作条件下的世界模型越来越多地被用作规划中的世界模型，然而，一个能生成与训练数据一致、看似合理且逼真的视频的世界模型，却可能导致糟糕的决策。我们探讨两个关键问题：（1）何时可以信任用于规划的世界模型；（2）当无法信任时应当采取什么措施。我们引入了CURE（认证、加权、展开、探索），一种基于证书引导的技术，用于评估世界模型是否值得信赖并决定后续行动：是增加训练数据的权重以消除模型偏差；在测试时展开更多样本；还是在缺乏支持（即训练数据覆盖规划者决策的程度不足）的情况下，通过收集新数据进行探索。我们在多个领域部署了CURE，涵盖了基于PhyWorld的模拟物理、MuJoCo臂控，以及仿真和真实视频环境中的Language-Table推物任务。我们的证书所信任的决策的遗憾值低于其不信任的决策（例如，在Language-Table模拟中为0.06对比0.38，在MuJoCo接触任务中为0.07对比0.38），而视频感知质量并不能识别出好的决策。通过聚焦于决策质量而非感知质量，在各个支持水平上，CURE相比最优悲观决策规则将遗憾值降低了10-25%，在给定相同数据的情况下，相比世界-动作模型、搜索及策略学习方法则降低了41-64%。

Authors: Raphael C. Kim, Michele Santacatterina, Jingsen Zhu, Ramin Zabih

TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation Manipulation

tool center point 4D scene representation robot manipulation cross-embodiment augmentation trajectory generation

简要说明：TCP4D 提出了一个统一模型，通过共享的 4D 场景表示，从单目机器人操作视频中跟踪工具中心点 (TCP) 位姿并生成未来 TCP 轨迹，支持跨本体数据增强，在多个基准和真实任务中表现优异。

TLDR: TCP4D introduces a unified model that tracks tool-center-point (TCP) poses and generates future TCP trajectories from monocular robot manipulation videos, using a shared 4D scene representation. It enables cross-embodiment data augmentation and demonstrates strong tracking and policy-generation performance on multiple benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作视频提供了丰富的视觉体验，然而从RGB观测中恢复机器人动作和夹爪状态标注仍然具有挑战性。以与具体本体无关的工具中心点（TCP）位姿作为动作空间，我们提出了TCP4D，一个统一模型，其中共享的4D场景表示既跟踪观测到的TCP运动，又生成未来的TCP轨迹。给定单目视频和初始2D TCP查询，跟踪器直接恢复SE(3)空间中的度量TCP位姿、夹爪状态，以及场景几何和相机参数。生成器沿着恢复的TCP轨迹从相同的4D表示中采样局部特征，然后将其与机器人观测和语言指令相结合，以预测未来的TCP状态。我们新的跨本体增强流程通过重定向恢复的运动并合成相应的观测，将现有的RGB视频转换为替代本体的演示，无需记录源机器人的状态。实验表明，跟踪器在DROID和RoboLab上实现了7.60毫米和16.07毫米的绝对轨迹误差，并且仅需十个演示即可适应新的本体。生成器在RoboTwin上实现了69.19%的平均成功率，并在两个真实世界任务上优于成熟的策略模型，而源演示与增强演示的联合训练相比仅使用增强训练，将目标机器人的成功率提高了41.5%。

Authors: Haosong Peng, Xiangyang Liu, Zhengshen Zhang, Yunfeng Fan, Tianyu Qi, Xin Xia, Yufeng Zhan, Wenchao Xu

Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D WorldModel

learned simulator world model ANYmal D legged robot model auditing

简要说明：本文审计了ANYmal D四足机器人的学习动力学模型（机器人世界模型），表明单步误差指标会误导多步控制的设计选择，集成不确定性校准不良，且模型精度无法可靠预测策略表现。

TLDR: This paper audits a learned dynamics model (the Robotic World Model) for the ANYmal D quadruped, showing that one-step error metrics misjudge design choices for multi-step control, ensemble uncertainties are miscalibrated, and that model accuracy does not reliably predict policy performance.

Abstract: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot. Training on the model's own rollouts beat one-step training at 368 steps on all ten held-out episodes (registered), although one-step training was better one step ahead. One-step checks therefore misjudge design choices: pruning 30% of the weights kept 90% of the model's skill one step ahead and 39% at 2 s. Ensemble disagreement ranked rollout error well (Spearman +0.90 at 100 steps), yet covered 4.6% of outcomes at one sigma, against 68% for a calibrated estimate, as each network's own variance collapses under the implemented loss. Two checks that need no recorded future ranked some pools of simulators well, but neither was shown better than 8-step error in a primary test. At the robot level, accuracy has not predicted walking: all 18 fine-tuned copies we tested predicted better than the released model one and eight steps ahead, yet 13 gave failing policies, and registered tests of whether any check ranks simulators by their policies were not settled. In a secondary test, running the authors' policy inside each simulator ranked them well. We also report nine of our own claims that we withdrew. Scope: one robot, one gait, simulated data, no hardware.

摘要（中文）：一只腿式机器人可以在一个学习得到的模拟器中学习行走：该模拟器是一个神经网络，用于预测机器人的下一状态，并基于自身预测向前运行。这类模拟器通常以单步预测的方式进行训练和检查，尽管策略会使用它们进行一百步甚至更多步的预测。我们在没有GPU的条件下，对一个已发表的系统进行了端到端的审计：即用于ANYmal D四足机器人的机器人世界模型（RWM）的动力学模型，以及其后续版本RWM-U的不确定性估计。我们重建了该模型，使其输出、损失和梯度与已发布代码完全一致，测量了101个训练好的模拟器、200个压缩副本以及38个采用其他三种架构的模拟器，并在我们手工构建的MuJoCo机器人模型中测试了在模拟器内训练的策略。在模型自身轨迹上训练的策略在全部十个保留的测试情节中，于368步时的表现优于单步训练（具有显著性），尽管在单步预测上单步训练更优。因此，单步检查会误判设计选择：剪枝30%的权重保留了模型单步预测时90%的技能，但在2秒预测时仅保留39%。集成模型的不一致性能较好地排序 rollout 误差（在100步时Spearman相关系数为+0.90），然而其在一个标准差范围内仅覆盖了4.6%的结果，而校准估计则覆盖了68%，这是因为在实现的损失函数下，每个网络自身的方差发生了塌缩。两种无需记录未来数据的检查方法在某些模拟器集合上排序良好，但在主要测试中，两者均未被证明优于8步误差。在机器人层面，预测精度并未预测行走表现：我们测试的18个微调副本在单步和八步预测上均优于已发布模型，但其中13个产生了失败策略，并且关于是否有任何检查方法能按策略对模拟器排序的显著性测试未得出确定结论。在辅助测试中，在每种模拟器内运行作者策略的结果排序良好。我们还报告了九项我们自行撤回的主张。适用范围：单一机器人、单一步态、模拟数据、无硬件实验。

Authors: Joyjeet Singh

CADENCE: Learning Acyclic Gaits for Model-Based Quadruped Locomotion Locomotion

quadruped locomotion model predictive control reinforcement learning acyclic gait foothold planning

简要说明：CADENCE 结合强化学习和模型预测控制，选择离散的迈步动作和摆动时间，学习适用于四足机器人的非周期性步态。

TLDR: CADENCE learns acyclic gaits for quadruped locomotion by combining reinforcement learning with model predictive control, selecting discrete stepping actions and swing times to adapt to terrain.

Abstract: Model-based quadruped controllers usually step on a cyclic gait, which lifts the legs in a fixed order on a fixed period, wherever the safe footholds are. We present CADENCE, a learned step planner with a small action space. Every 40 ms, it picks one of at most 65 discrete choices: no step, or one leg's step to a safe foothold. It also predicts a swing time. We train CADENCE by reinforcement learning on top of a convex model predictive controller (MPC). Nothing prescribes a gait: there is no gait schedule, and the reward has no gait term, only a cost per step. The one structural constraint is that at most two legs may swing at once. The policy we analyzed developed an acyclic gait, with no fixed period or stepping order, yet it still paired diagonal legs. An inverse footstep model (IFM), fitted on a controller's logged steps, turns each foothold into a command. With only the IFM refitted, on fewer than 20,000 steps, CADENCE ran frozen on OCS2's nonlinear MPC. In simulated trials on a range of terrains (26% to 49% voids) and speeds (0.1 m/s and 0.2 m/s), it succeeded in 85.1% (mean of five seeds), against 67.8% for OCS2-Trot, 65.5% for OCS2-Single, and 39.6% in a static walk ablation of CADENCE. At 49% voids, it succeeded in 72.9%, against 43.0% for OCS2-Trot.

摘要（中文）：基于模型的四足控制器通常采用周期性步态，即以固定周期、固定顺序抬腿，而不考虑安全落脚点的位置。我们提出了CADENCE，一种具有小动作空间的学习型步态规划器。每隔40毫秒，它从至多65个离散选项中选择一个：不迈步，或将某条腿迈至安全落脚点。它还预测摆动时长。我们在凸模型预测控制器（MPC）之上，通过强化学习训练CADENCE。没有预设任何步态：不存在步态时间表，奖励函数中也没有步态项，仅有每步的代价。唯一的结构约束是至多两条腿同时摆动。我们分析得到的策略发展出了一种非周期步态，没有固定周期或迈步顺序，但仍保持对角腿配对。一个基于控制器记录步态拟合的逆落脚点模型（IFM）将每个落脚点转化为控制指令。仅需重新拟合IFM，在少于20,000步的数据上，CADENCE即可在OCS2的非线性MPC上冻结运行。在一系列地形（空隙率26%至49%）和速度（0.1 m/s和0.2 m/s）的仿真试验中，CADENCE的成功率为85.1%（五个随机种子的平均值），而OCS2-Trot为67.8%，OCS2-Single为65.5%，CADENCE的静态行走消融实验则为39.6%。在49%空隙率下，CADENCE成功率达到72.9%，而OCS2-Trot仅为43.0%。

Authors: Owen Sullivan, Sourav Selvaraj, Mahdi Agheli

RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification Manipulation

deformable objects simulation verification robotic grasping asset dataset sim-to-real

简要说明：RFW-S 是一个包含 83,365 个可变形物体、覆盖 485 个类别的大规模仿真验证数据集，通过自动化流程和独立仿真验证构建，并在机器人抓取和真实世界操作中进行了评估。

TLDR: RFW-S is a large-scale, simulation-verified dataset of 83,365 deformable objects across 485 categories, built with an automated pipeline and independent simulation verification, and evaluated for robotic grasping and sim-to-real manipulation.

Abstract: Large-scale robotic simulation requires diverse deformable objects with executable physical properties and realistic interaction behaviors. However, existing 3D asset collections primarily emphasize visual diversity, while scalable physical construction and verification remain challenging. We introduce RFW-S, a large-scale dataset of 83,365 simulation-verified assets spanning 485 everyday categories across five structural families: soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, and bags. We develop an automated pipeline integrating reference-guided 3D generation, structure-aware physical modeling, and LLM-assisted parameter estimation and calibration. To ensure physical reliability, we introduce an independent simulation verification framework that evaluates object behaviors under interactions distinct from those used for parameter calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of independent verification and characterize deformable responses under different physical configurations. We further evaluate robotic grasping in terms of both task success and object integrity, and demonstrate the physical realism of our simulated objects through sim-to-real replay of fragile-object manipulation. RFW-S provides a scalable foundation for physically grounded simulation and embodied robotic learning.

摘要（中文）：大规模机器人仿真需要具备可执行物理属性及真实交互行为的多样化可变形物体。然而，现有三维资产数据集主要强调视觉多样性，在可扩展的物理构建与验证方面仍面临挑战。我们提出RFW-S，一个包含83,365个经仿真验证的资产的大规模数据集，涵盖五个结构家族中的485个日常类别：软固体、布料片材、壳体、服装和包袋。我们开发了一条自动化流水线，集成了参考引导的三维生成、结构感知的物理建模以及大语言模型辅助的参数估计与标定。为确保物理可靠性，我们引入了一个独立的仿真验证框架，在与参数标定所用交互不同的条件下评估物体行为。大量实验证明了独立验证的有效性，并刻画了不同物理配置下的可变形响应。我们还从任务成功率和物体完整性两方面评估了机器人抓取性能，并通过易碎物体操作的仿真到现实迁移实验，验证了我们仿真物体的物理真实性。RFW-S为基于物理的仿真和具身机器人学习提供了可扩展的基础。

Authors: Jiarui Guo, Saining Zhang, Jiaying Wan, Jiawei Weng, Junhao Chen, Rui Zhang, Yuanbo Lyu, Zhiheng Lee, Peishuo Li, Jingrun Du, Weiqing Xiao, Weiyi Lin, Zenan Meng, Hu Wei, Lin Qu, Zongzheng Zhang, Hao Zhao, Chaojian Li

Making Future-Predictive Representations Actionable WorldModel

world action model future prediction robot policy generalization LIBERO-Plus

简要说明：本文提出RelayWAM，通过将未来预测表示显式中继到动作路径，改进了世界动作模型，在机器人任务中提升了泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces RelayWAM to improve world action models by explicitly relaying future-predictive representations into the action pathway, boosting generalization in robot tasks.

Abstract: Recent world action models (WAMs) drop future prediction at inference, assuming that representations learned through auxiliary future supervision still benefit action generation. However, our layerwise analysis of Fast-WAM reveals a depth-dependent mismatch: while probes decode future state transitions more accurately from deeper visual layers, the gradients and visual focuses of the future and action objectives increasingly diverge with depth, leaving much of this predictive information unused by the action pathway. To address this issue, we introduce RelayWAM, which adds an explicit transition space between the video and action backbones. Conditioned on the task instruction, robot state, and current action estimate, recurrent transition layers extract step-relevant predictive cues across depth and relay them directly into the action attention, without generating future frames at inference. Experiments show that RelayWAM substantially amplifies the benefit of future supervision, translating into stronger generalization under distribution shifts in both simulation and real-world robot tasks. On LIBERO-Plus, RelayWAM achieves 72.03% mean success, compared to 56.42% without future supervision and 51.50% for Fast-WAM.

摘要（中文）：近期世界动作模型（WAMs）在推理时放弃未来预测，其假设是通过辅助未来监督所学到的表征仍有益于动作生成。然而，我们对Fast-WAM的逐层分析揭示了一种深度相关的失配现象：虽然探针从更深的视觉层能更准确地解码未来状态转换，但随着深度增加，未来目标与动作目标的梯度和视觉焦点逐渐分化，导致这些预测信息中有很大一部分未被动作通路利用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RelayWAM，在视频骨干网络与动作骨干网络之间增加了一个显式的过渡空间。在任务指令、机器人状态和当前动作估计的条件约束下，循环过渡层跨深度提取与步骤相关的预测线索，并将其直接传递至动作注意力机制中，而在推理时不生成任何未来帧。实验表明，RelayWAM显著放大了未来监督的收益，在仿真与真实机器人任务中均体现出更强的分布偏移泛化能力。在LIBERO-Plus上，RelayWAM实现了72.03%的平均成功率，而未经未来监督的基线为56.42%，Fast-WAM为51.50%。

Authors: Fangchuan Wang, Hao Zhang, Qiyan Zhao, Huanqi Zhao, Guanting Ye, Xu-Yao Zhang, Yuqing Gao

Physics-Informed Tactile-based Shape Estimation of Deformable Linear Objects Manipulation

tactile sensing shape estimation deformable linear objects Vision Transformer physics-informed loss

简要说明：本文提出一种基于物理信息的视觉变换器，仅通过触觉图像估计可变形线性物体的三维形状，无需视觉，实现了高精度重建和向新材料的迁移。

TLDR: This paper proposes a physics-informed Vision Transformer that estimates the 3D shape of deformable linear objects from tactile images alone, without vision, achieving accurate reconstruction and transfer to new materials.

Abstract: Accurate shape estimation of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation, often hindered by visual occlusions and the high-dimensional configuration space of flexible materials. While Force/Torque (F/T) and vision-centric methods have been proposed, they frequently struggle with grasp-site ambiguities and environmental interference. In this letter, we investigate the hypothesis that global shape estimation can be achieved through tactile sensing and proprioception, without any visual perception. We contend that dense, high-resolution tactile imprints capture critical boundary conditions and contact gradients that are sufficient to resolve the high-dimensional configuration of the DLO. To prove this, we introduce a Physics-Informed Vision Transformer (ViT) framework that maps tactile images to a 3D vertex chain. By leveraging self-attention mechanisms and a physics-weighted loss function, our model enforces structural priors to ensure that the predicted geometry adheres to the object's physical manifold. Experimental results demonstrate that our tactile-based approach achieves superior reconstruction accuracy across Euclidean and Chamfer metrics. Furthermore, we demonstrate the efficiency of this modality, achieving model transfer to novel DLO materials and geometries. Our findings suggest that tactile feedback provides a robust and computationally efficient alternative for DLO state estimation in visually degraded or occluded environments.

摘要（中文）：可变形线性物体（DLOs）的精确形状估计是机器人操作中的一项基础性挑战，通常受限于视觉遮挡以及柔性材料的高维构型空间。尽管基于力/力矩（F/T）和视觉的方法已被提出，但这些方法常常在抓取点模糊性和环境干扰方面表现不佳。在本研究中，我们探讨了这样一个假设：仅通过触觉感知和本体感觉即可实现全局形状估计，而无需任何视觉感知。我们认为，密集、高分辨率的触觉印记能够捕获关键的边界条件和接触梯度，这些信息足以解析DLO的高维构型。为验证这一假设，我们提出了一种物理信息视觉变换器（ViT）框架，将触觉图像映射为三维顶点链。通过利用自注意力机制和物理加权损失函数，我们的模型强制执行结构先验，确保预测的几何形状符合对象的物理流形。实验结果表明，我们基于触觉的方法在欧氏距离和Chamfer距离指标上均实现了优越的重建精度。此外，我们证明了该模态的高效性，实现了对新型DLO材料和几何形状的模型迁移。我们的研究结果表明，在视觉退化或遮挡环境中，触觉反馈为DLO状态估计提供了一种鲁棒且计算高效的替代方案。

Authors: Rotem Atari, Stav Ashur, Avishai Sintov

Fly as Instructed: Refining World-Action Policies for UAV Vision-Language Navigation VLN

world-action learning vision-language navigation UAV instruction following Gaussian-scene post-training

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于无人机视觉语言导航的世界动作学习框架，结合了语言条件动作后训练、指令消耗预测和基于高斯场景的后训练以增强避障能力，并通过闭环和真实世界飞行验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a world-action learning framework for UAV vision-language navigation, integrating language-conditioned action post-training, instruction-consumption prediction for task tracking, and Gaussian-scene post-training for obstacle avoidance, with validation in closed-loop and real-world flights.

Abstract: Natural language-guided UAV navigation enables intuitive human-robot interaction and flexible autonomous flight in complex environments. However, reliable navigation requires accurate instruction following, continuous task progress tracking, and safe obstacle avoidance, which remain challenging for existing world-action models that primarily focus on action prediction. To address these limitations, we propose a world-action learning framework that integrates three complementary mechanisms: a language-conditioned action interface with targeted post-training for instruction-responsive motion, recurrent instruction-consumption prediction to track task progress and determine termination, and Gaussian-scene post-training to enhance obstacle avoidance through trajectory imitation and differentiable geometric feedback. Closed-loop evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate improvements in sequential task completion, safe goal reaching, and timely termination. Furthermore, direct one-step denoising reduces inference overhead, and real-world indoor and outdoor flights validate the framework's effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：自然语言引导的无人机导航能够实现直观的人机交互，并在复杂环境中进行灵活的自主飞行。然而，可靠导航要求准确遵循指令、持续跟踪任务进度并安全避开障碍，这对于现有主要聚焦于动作预测的世界-行动模型而言仍具挑战性。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种世界-行动学习框架，该框架整合了三种互补机制：面向指令响应动作的语言条件动作接口，并通过针对性后训练实现；循环指令消费预测，用于跟踪任务进度并决定终止时机；以及高斯场景后训练，通过轨迹模仿和可微几何反馈来增强避障能力。闭环评估和消融实验表明，该框架在顺序任务完成、安全到达目标及及时终止方面均有显著提升。此外，直接一步去噪降低了推理开销，真实室内外飞行实验进一步验证了该框架的有效性。

Authors: Zhexuan Zhou, Yanke Sun, Yuhan Zong, Youmin Gong, Jie Mei

CaFe: Causally Faithful Conditional Traffic Scenario Generation AutonomousDriving

intent leakage language-conditioned traffic simulation counterfactual test diffusion-forcing closed-loop simulation

简要说明：本文正式化了语言条件交通模拟中的意图泄漏问题，提出配对干预测试和基于反事实的数据集，并引入CaFe双流扩散强制模拟器，在保持真实感的同时消除私有意图泄漏。

TLDR: The paper formalizes intent leakage in language-conditioned traffic simulation, proposes a paired intervention test and a counterfactual-based dataset, and introduces CaFe, a dual-stream diffusion-forcing simulator that eliminates private-intent leakage while maintaining realism.

Abstract: Language-conditioned traffic simulation enables scalable test scenarios steered by natural language. The goal is to control selected agents while surrounding traffic reacts to their observed behaviour. For example, a vehicle instructed to cut in late should cause the following vehicle to brake only when the manoeuvre becomes observable. Yet simulators can leak private instructions across agents, causing surrounding vehicles to react before the instructed behaviour becomes observable. Such premature reactions defuse desired events and alter the ensuing closed-loop scenario. Existing benchmarks measure what agents do, not what they could have known, leaving this failure unmeasured. We formalise it as intent leakage and address it through evaluation, data and modelling. Our paired intervention test holds an instructed agent's executed trajectory fixed while varying its private instruction, isolating leakage-induced changes in surrounding agents. We also construct WOMD-PACT, an automatically generated, verifiable dataset of 531,099 WOMD scenes with timed behaviour tags with reaction episodes identified through a counterfactual ghost test and grounded private instructions. Finally, we introduce CaFe, a dual-stream diffusion-forcing simulator fine-tuned in closed loop that restricts inter-agent interactions to public beliefs, preserving legitimate anticipation without leaking private intent. Our evaluation reveals that existing conditioning designs displace 23-83% of nearby uninstructed agents through private-intent leakage, even when the instructed agent's executed motion is held fixed. CaFe eliminates measurable leakage while maintaining comparable WOSAC realism (0.763), demonstrating that causal faithfulness can be enforced without sacrificing measured simulation realism.

摘要（中文）：语言条件交通模拟使得由自然语言控制的可扩展测试场景成为可能。其目标是控制选定的智能体，同时周围的交通对其可观察到的行为作出反应。例如，被指示进行晚切入操作的车辆应当使得后方车辆仅在操作变为可观察时才开始制动。然而，模拟器可能在智能体之间泄露私有指令，导致周围车辆在被指示行为变得可观察之前就作出反应。这种过早反应削弱了预期事件，并改变了后续的闭环场景。现有基准衡量的是智能体做了什么，而非它们可能知道了什么，因此未能对这一失效现象进行度量。我们将其形式化为意图泄露，并通过评估、数据和建模来加以解决。我们的配对干预测试在保持被指示智能体执行轨迹不变的同时改变其私有指令，从而分离出泄露引起的周围智能体行为变化。我们还构建了WOMD-PACT数据集，这是一个自动生成、可验证的数据集，包含531,099个WOMD场景，带有计时行为标签，通过反事实幽灵测试识别反应片段，并提供基于实际情境的私有指令标注。最后，我们引入了CaFe，一种双流扩散强迫模拟器，通过闭环微调将智能体间的交互限制在公共信念范围内，在保留合法预期的同时避免泄露私有意图。我们的评估表明，即使在被指示智能体执行运动保持不变的情况下，现有条件设计仍会通过私有意图泄露使23%至83%的邻近未指示智能体发生位移。CaFe消除了可测量的泄露，同时保持了相当的WOSAC真实感（0.763），证明因果忠实性可以在不牺牲模拟真实感度量的前提下得以实现。

Authors: Steven Yu Tung, Shubham Vaijanath Phoolari, Christoph Lauer, Abhinav Valada, Steven Peters

Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Balance on Dynamically Responsive Supports Locomotion

sustained balance dynamically responsive supports Lyapunov-inspired criterion differentiable model rollouts proprioception

简要说明：本文提出了 LISST，一种在动态响应支撑物上实现持续平衡的学习框架，利用李雅普诺夫启发的准则和可微分模型展开训练策略，仅依赖本体感觉并减少残余振荡。

TLDR: This paper introduces LISST, a learning framework for sustained balance on dynamically responsive supports, using a Lyapunov-inspired criterion and differentiable model rollouts to train a policy that operates with onboard proprioception and reduces residual oscillations.

Abstract: Conventional balance formulations often assume a rigid, stationary support, decoupling body stabilization from support motion. This assumption becomes inadequate on mechanically responsive supports, creating a coupled control challenge: corrective body motions intended to restore equilibrium can also excite support motion. We formulate sustained balance as a coupled regulation problem that coordinates equilibrium restoration with suppression of motion induced by the robot's own corrections. We introduce LISST (Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Stabilization), a learning framework that accounts for how earlier actions shape the conditions for subsequent corrections. It uses recent observations to support immediate adjustments and longer histories to characterize persistent motion, with physical supervision relating the learned representation to robot-support behavior. To evaluate corrective actions, LISST uses coupled dynamics to assess both imbalance and the direction of motion. A Lyapunov-inspired criterion measures progress over finite windows, accommodating the transients required to restore balance. This physical evaluation guides joint-level policy learning through backpropagation through differentiable model rollouts. Privileged guidance focuses training on difficult states reached by the deployment policy and is transferred through distillation. The resulting policy operates using only onboard proprioception. Real-world experiments demonstrate that LISST maintains balance while limiting residual oscillations during continuous interaction with a dynamically responsive support. Video: youtu.be/iGHU7S4wPyw.

摘要（中文）：常规的平衡控制公式通常假设支撑面是刚性的、静止的，从而将身体稳定性与支撑运动解耦。然而，在具有机械响应的支撑面上，这一假设不再成立，进而产生了一个耦合控制难题：为恢复平衡而进行的身体纠偏动作，也可能同时激发支撑面的运动。本文将持续性平衡视为一个耦合调节问题，协调平衡恢复与由机器人自身纠偏动作引发的支撑运动抑制。我们提出了LISST（李雅普诺夫启发的持续稳定化）学习框架，该框架考虑了早期动作如何影响后续纠偏所需的条件。它利用近期观测数据支持即时调整，并借助更长时间的历史信息刻画持续性运动，同时通过物理监督将学习到的表征与机器人-支撑面行为相关联。为评估纠偏动作，LISST采用耦合动力学来同时判断失衡程度与运动方向。一种受李雅普诺夫启发的判据在有限时间窗口内衡量进展，可容纳恢复平衡所需的瞬态过程。这一物理评估通过可微分模型展开的反向传播引导关节级策略学习。特权引导专注于部署策略所到达的困难状态进行训练，并通过蒸馏进行迁移。最终得到的策略仅依赖机载本体感知运行。真实世界实验表明，LISST在与动态响应支撑面持续交互过程中，能够在维持平衡的同时限制残余振荡。视频链接：youtu.be/iGHU7S4wPyw。

Authors: Changyan Li, Guiyin Tian, Jing Xia, Shiyan Hu

Zero-Shot Compositional Generalization for Embodied Manipulation Manipulation

zero-shot compositional generalization embodied manipulation forward kinematics cross-robot supervision visual policy

简要说明：本文提出了一种几何监督训练框架，使具身操作能够实现零样本组合泛化，通过标定的正向运动学与跨机器人监督，让机器人能执行未见过但由熟悉机器人和技能组合而成的任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes a geometry-supervised training framework that enables zero-shot compositional generalization for embodied manipulation, allowing robots to perform skills they have never seen by recombining familiar robots and skills through calibrated forward kinematics and cross-robot supervision.

Abstract: Robot demonstrations are collected on different embodiments, leaving many robot-skill combinations unobserved. Pooling these data shares visual knowledge, while joint labels remain tied to the demonstrating kinematic chain. We propose a geometry-supervised training framework for zero-shot composition of familiar robots and skills. The central insight is that a demonstrated command provides a tool-space target for every robot that can realize it. Calibrated forward kinematics supplies this supervision to foreign native action interfaces without their joint labels for that skill. Native reconstruction retains demonstrated configurations, and positive reachability checks select targets for cross-robot supervision. A visual policy learns to predict shared actions and executes through the target robot's native decoder. During policy learning, one prediction receives geometric supervision through both source and foreign native realizations. Matched supervision controls, repeated policy training and evaluations across three backbones and two simulators demonstrate improved transfer to missing robot-task combinations.

摘要（中文）：机器人演示是在不同本体上收集的，导致许多机器人-技能组合未被观测到。汇总这些数据可以共享视觉知识，但关节标签仍与演示所用的运动链绑定。我们提出了一种几何监督的训练框架，用于熟悉机器人与技能的零样本组合。核心洞见在于，演示指令为每个能够实现它的机器人提供了一个工具空间目标。标定的正运动学为外部原生动作接口提供了这种监督，而无需该技能对应的关节标签。原生重建保留了演示配置，正向可达性检查则为跨机器人监督选择目标。视觉策略学习预测共享动作，并通过目标机器人的原生解码器执行。在策略学习过程中，一个预测同时通过源机器人与外部原生实现接收几何监督。匹配的监督控制、跨三种骨干网络和两种仿真器的重复策略训练与评估表明，该框架在缺失机器人-任务组合上的迁移性能得到了提升。

Authors: Baicheng Li, Wenkang Qin, Youqi Pan, Dongxiao Mao, Yukun Zhou, Chuanfu Shen, Dong Wu, Shunkai Zhou, Zike Yan, Wei Sui, Hongbin Zha

Learning Accurate End-Effector Trajectory Tracking with Inertial Feedback for a Quadruped Manipulator Manipulation

quadruped manipulator reinforcement learning inertial feedback trajectory tracking end-effector

简要说明：本文提出了一种利用末端执行器惯性反馈的强化学习框架，以提高四足机械臂的轨迹跟踪精度，并在仿真和真实实验中显著降低了跟踪误差。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework using end-effector inertial feedback to improve trajectory tracking accuracy for quadruped manipulators, demonstrating significant error reduction in both simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Accurate end-effector trajectory tracking on quadruped manipulators is challenging because uncertainties in actuators, foot-ground contact, and geometric errors are propagated through the leg-arm kinematic chain. Detecting such errors requires sensing beyond joint encoders that can capture the effects of these uncertainties on the robot's motion, since joint encoders only provide measurements at the actuated joints and cannot fully observe mechanical errors such as backlash, dimensional inaccuracies, or structural deformation. This work addresses these challenges using a reinforcement learning framework with end-effector (EE) inertial feedback, targeting local high-accuracy manipulation while maintaining a nominal body pose and support configuration without intentional body motion or foot repositioning. The learned policy uses EE inertial measurements to compensate for tracking errors induced by uncertainties throughout the leg-arm system that cannot be fully inferred from proprioception alone. Simulation and real-world experiments on continuous EE trajectory tracking show overall improvements relative to nominal and proprioception-only baselines. In real-world experiments, the proposed policy reduces the MoCap-based RMSE by 17.3% and 28.0% relative to the nominal baseline under the two in-distribution (ID) command conditions, respectively, and by an additional 12.6% and 15.9% relative to the proprioception-only baseline. Furthermore, the trajectory-wise RMSE between FK-reconstructed and motion-capture-measured end-effector positions averaged 12.61+-2.15mm (mean+-standard deviation) across 24 controller-trajectory combinations, revealing a substantial discrepancy between nominal kinematic reconstruction and measured end-effector motion.

摘要（中文）：四足机械臂末端执行器的精确轨迹跟踪极具挑战性，因为执行器、足地接触中的不确定性以及几何误差会通过腿臂运动链传播。检测此类误差需要超越关节编码器的感知手段，以捕捉这些不确定性对机器人运动的影响，因为关节编码器仅在驱动关节处提供测量值，无法全面观测诸如背隙、尺寸误差或结构变形等机械误差。本研究利用基于强化学习的框架，结合末端执行器惯性反馈，致力于在保持标称机体姿态和支撑构型、不进行有意机体运动或足部重新定位的前提下，实现局部高精度操作。学习得到的策略利用末端执行器惯性测量来补偿由腿臂系统中无法仅凭本体感觉完全推断的不确定性所引发的跟踪误差。连续末端执行器轨迹跟踪的仿真和真实实验表明，相较于标称基线和仅依赖本体感觉的基线，所提方法整体性能有所提升。在真实实验中，所提策略在两种分布内命令条件下，相较于标称基线，基于动作捕捉系统的均方根误差分别降低了17.3%和28.0%；相较于仅依赖本体感觉的基线，进一步分别降低了12.6%和15.9%。此外，在24种控制器-轨迹组合中，正运动学重建与动作捕捉测量的末端执行器位置之间的逐轨迹均方根误差平均为12.61±2.15毫米（均值±标准差），揭示了标称运动学重建与实测末端执行器运动之间存在显著偏差。

Authors: Dohyeon Kim, Seungyong Han, Yeongtae Jung

VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

speculative decoding vision-language-action models autoregressive decoding manipulation lossless acceleration

简要说明：VSpark 通过校准噪声回滚、特征对齐和连续重用，在四种 VLA 和四个操作基准上实现了 1.28 至 2.10 倍的加速，且保持无损解码。

TLDR: VSpark accelerates autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models via speculative decoding with calibrated noise rollouts, feature alignment, and continuation reuse, achieving 1.28x-2.10x speedup losslessly on four VLAs and benchmarks.

Abstract: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

摘要（中文）：我们的目标是加速自回归视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs），该模型每次仅生成一个机器人动作令牌。推测解码使这一目标成为可能：一个轻量级草稿模型一次性提出多个令牌，VLA 在单次前向传播中对其进行验证，仅接受与其自身预测相匹配的令牌，从而保持解码无损。然而，在机器人控制中，这种加速效果受到限制，因为许多不同的令牌编码了几乎相同的运动，即使草稿接近正确动作，仍会被拒绝。为解决这一问题，我们提出的方法 VSpark 基于三项设计选择：（i）使用带校准动作噪声的轨迹回放，使草稿模型暴露于更广泛的机器人状态；（ii）特征对齐，训练草稿模型匹配 VLA 的隐藏特征，而不仅仅匹配其输出令牌；（iii）延续复用，将 VLA 在已计算但被拒绝的草稿上的预测保留下来，作为下一步验证的候选，而非丢弃。在四种具有不同动作分词器的 VLA 及四个操作基准上，VSpark 实现了 1.28 倍至 2.10 倍的加速，同时保持 VLA 解码头无损。

Authors: Suho Yoo, Youngjoon Jang, Hyebin Cho, Taeyeop Lee, Jaewook Jeong, Joon Son Chung

Task Convergent Flow Matching for Generative Robotics Manipulation

Flow Matching Task Convergence Inference-time Refinement CMA-ES Physics-based Rollouts

简要说明：本文针对机器人操作中的流匹配策略，提出了一种基于任务中心的推理时优化框架，通过并行物理仿真、漏斗约束和径向分位带约束的CMA-ES，确保任务收敛并提升PushT和堆叠任务的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies in robotic manipulation, using parallel physics-based rollouts, funnel constraints, and CMA-ES with radial quantile bands to ensure task convergence and improve success rates on PushT and cube stacking.

Abstract: Successful manipulation requires the manipulated objects to progress toward a desired task outcome. Generative policies can produce plausible robot motions without ensuring this progress, allowing successive action chunks to stall or undo earlier changes to the scene. We introduce a task-centric inference-time refinement framework for flow matching policies that evaluates candidate action chunks through parallel physics-based rollouts and searches for motions satisfying sufficient conditions for task convergence. Task-level performance funnels bound temporary regressions while requiring net progress over each chunk. We establish sufficient conditions under which repeated funnel satisfaction yields convergence throughout execution, and use interval-wise Lipschitz bounds to verify continuous-time funnel satisfaction from sampled rollouts. To accommodate contact-rich hybrid dynamics, we refine the flow's source seeds using derivative-free Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), constrained to radial quantile bands of the source distribution to help retain the learned motion prior. This formulation supports both Euclidean and pose-valued Riemannian Flow Matching (RMFM) policies. On PushT and three-cube stacking, refinement raises success from 31.3% to 88.5% and from 77.0% to 86.0%. On PushT, whose coverage score responds continuously to the motion of the block, a learned funnel lowers the average maximum loss of achieved progress by 19% relative to constraining the endpoint of each chunk alone, at a similar success rate. With the radial band, 11.3% of the executed motion windows are out of distribution, a rate within the range of held-out demonstrations, compared with 34.1% for an unconstrained search.

摘要（中文）：成功的操控要求被操控对象朝着期望的任务结果推进。生成式策略能够产生看似合理的机器人动作，却无法保证这种推进，从而可能导致连续的动作片段停滞甚至撤销先前对场景所做的改变。我们提出了一种面向流匹配策略的任务中心式推理时精炼框架，该框架通过并行的基于物理的 rollout 评估候选动作片段，并搜索满足任务收敛充分条件的动作。任务级性能漏斗允许暂时的回退，但要求每个片段具有净进展。我们建立了充分条件，在此条件下，反复满足漏斗要求即可保证整个执行过程中的收敛性，并使用区间逐段 Lipschitz 界从采样 rollout 验证连续时间内的漏斗满足性。为适应接触丰富的混合动力学，我们使用无导数的协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）对流的源种子进行精炼，并约束在源分布的径向分位带内，以帮助保留学得的运动先验。该公式同时支持欧几里得流匹配和取值于黎曼流形上的黎曼流匹配（RMFM）策略。在 PushT 和三立方体堆叠任务中，精炼将成功率分别从 31.3% 提升至 88.5%，以及从 77.0% 提升至 86.0%。在 PushT 中，其覆盖率得分对块的运动连续响应，学得的漏斗相较于仅约束每个片段终点的方法，在成功率相近的情况下，将已取得进展的平均最大损失降低了 19%。使用径向分位带时，执行的运动窗口中仅有 11.3% 属于分布外，这一比例处于留出演示的范围内，而无约束搜索时为 34.1%。

Authors: Lorenzo Paiola, Maximilian Stölzle, Giorgio Grioli, Daniela Rus, Cosimo Della Santina

Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching Manipulation

World Action Models distillation bimanual manipulation video-action generation closed-loop control

简要说明：本文提出了锚定路径匹配（APM），一种用于世界动作模型的蒸馏方法，通过改进少步联合视频-动作生成，提升了双臂操控的效率，并降低了闭环控制的延迟。

TLDR: This paper introduces Anchored Path Matching (APM), a distillation method for World Action Models that improves few-step joint video-action generation for bimanual manipulation, enabling efficient closed-loop control with reduced latency.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step teacher.Project page: https://jialonglong.github.io/Anchored-Path-Matching/.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过迭代去噪联合生成未来视频和机器人动作。少步蒸馏减少了模型评估次数，但其粗糙的更新可能使学生模型偏离教师模型的轨迹。我们提出了锚定路径匹配（APM），该方法对学生模型所到达的状态的端点预测和短时过渡预测进行监督。从每个状态出发，我们将教师模型继续运行至零噪声，并将其端点及第一个中间状态作为目标。模态路由适配器学习从相同起始状态同时匹配两个目标。当两个梯度发生冲突时，锚定优先更新保留端点梯度，并在各模态内移除局部梯度的相反分量。一个检查点即可支持1步、2步和4步联合生成。采样预算可在部署时自由选择，无需重新训练或查询教师模型。在RoboTwin 2.0上，我们仅使用Clean示范进行训练，并直接在域随机化的Random设置上评估。在单步设置下，与相同推理预算下持续基础蒸馏相比，APM在Clean上的闭环成功率提升了2.0个百分点，在Random上提升了1.4个百分点。视频峰值信噪比（PSNR）从30.169 dB提升至32.317 dB，结构相似性（SSIM）和学习感知图像块相似性（LPIPS）也均有改善。在两个真实机器人任务中，APM相比单步教师模型提升了成功率，并将控制周期延迟相对八步教师模型降低了\(21.3\times\)。项目页面：https://jialonglong.github.io/Anchored-Path-Matching/。

Authors: Jialong Liu, Junjie He, Yandu Chen, Bin Zhou, Heng Su, Peijun Tang, Jianan Wang, Changhao Chen

InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation VLA

vision-language-action (VLA) geometric guidance agentic manipulation recursive self-improvement flow-based policies

简要说明：InteractVLA 提出了一种双向几何接口，使预训练的流式 VLA 策略在智能体操纵中可引导和可检查，在多个基准上提升了成功率，并实现了递归自我改进。

TLDR: InteractVLA introduces a bidirectional geometric interface that makes pretrained flow-based VLAs steerable and inspectable for agentic manipulation, improving success rates on several benchmarks and enabling recursive self-improvement.

Abstract: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.

摘要（中文）：现有的智能体操控系统将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略视为不透明的、仅基于语言的原始单元：当策略调用在陌生指令或场景扰动下失败时，智能体无法引导其行为，只能陷入无效的重试或代价高昂的人工接管。我们提出InteractVLA框架，通过一种与视觉-语言智能体之间的双向几何接口，将预训练的基于流匹配的VLA转化为几何上可操控且可检查的工具。在前向方向上，测试时的几何引导通过可微分的指令到姿态映射，将智能体指定的末端执行器目标转化为经由动作专家传递的输入梯度；同时，软时间目标对齐将到达时间视为潜在的执行索引，以匹配目标姿态而不扭曲策略的趋近运动。在后向方向上，动作信息增强的智能体细化将生成的动作片段和校准后的相机重投影反馈给智能体，使其能够诊断空间差异、修正后续VLA调用的目标，或在引导轨迹之上局部调整运动片段。使VLA可控不仅提升了在线智能体工具使用能力，还解锁了高效的递归自我改进（RSI），在LIBERO-Plus上达到了99.4%的最新性能，在RoboDojo上达到48.62%，在RoboCasa365上达到89.4%。项目页面：https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/。

Authors: Chen Zhao, Zipeng Ye, Shifeng Bao, Yihan Lin, Haitao Shen, Yining Luo, Yuchen Xie, Jing Zhang

JointGV: Structure-Aware Correction of Visual World Models with Parallel Graph Dynamics for Long-Horizon Modeling WorldModel

visual world models scene graphs long-horizon prediction robot control dynamics correction

简要说明：本文提出JointGV，一种通过将视觉世界模型与任务条件场景图耦合来修正其漂移的插件，提高了机器人控制的长时程预测能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces JointGV, a plug-in that corrects drift in visual world models by coupling them with task-conditioned scene graphs, improving long-horizon prediction for robot control.

Abstract: Visual world models predict future visual states conditioned on actions, but recursive errors in entity poses and spatial relations limit their long-horizon prediction for robot planning and control. We ask whether a separately predicted relational state can correct this drift without restructuring the visual model. This is challenging because graph nodes and visual states share neither elements nor a feature space. We propose Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction (JointGV), a plug-in based on a cross-granularity dynamics hypothesis: despite their different representations, graph-node and visual-state changes describe the same physical transition. JointGV rolls out a task-conditioned scene graph alongside the visual world model, couples their predicted changes, and combines the resulting graph-motion context with graph-predicted node positions to compute a bounded residual. Graph-learning and correction gradients do not propagate into the original visual dynamics. We attach JointGV to DINO-WM (spatial tokens) and DreamerV3 (a global latent state), evaluating both on DMC Cheetah Run and Walker Walk across three seeds and extending the evaluation to contact-rich manipulation with DMC Finger Turn Hard. Across 32-step rollouts, JointGV improves structural and visual-prediction accuracy, reducing joint-position error by 11--28\%. For spatial tokens, learned graph--visual change coupling gives lower error than broadcasting the same mean graph-motion context to every token, particularly when non-adjacent parts appear close together in the image. On real-robot inverted-pendulum sequences, JointGV reduces DINO-WM's 32-step pole-angle error from $12.56^\circ$ to $6.69^\circ$ and improves DreamerV3 and LeWorldModel as well. In simulated inverted-pendulum control, an actor trained with JointGV-corrected rollouts completes 46 of 50 episodes, compared with none using the original rollouts.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型根据动作预测未来的视觉状态，但实体姿态和空间关系中的递归误差限制了其在机器人规划与控制中的长期预测能力。我们探究一个关键问题：是否可以通过单独预测的关系状态来纠正这种漂移，而无需重构视觉模型本身。这一挑战在于图节点与视觉状态既没有共享元素，也不处于同一特征空间。为此，我们提出联合图-视觉动力学校正方法（JointGV），这是一种基于跨粒度动力学假设的插件：尽管图节点状态和视觉状态表示形式不同，但它们的变化描述的是同一次物理转移。JointGV在视觉世界模型旁同时滚动生成任务条件场景图，耦合并预测两者的变化，并将得到的图运动上下文与图预测的节点位置相结合，计算出一个有界残差。图学习和校正的梯度不会反向传播到原始视觉动力学中。我们将JointGV应用于DINO-WM（空间令牌）和DreamerV3（全局潜状态），在三组随机种子下对DMC Cheetah Run和Walker Walk进行评估，并将评估扩展到接触丰富的操作任务，即DMC Finger Turn Hard。在32步的滚动预测中，JointGV提升了结构预测和视觉预测的准确性，将关节位置误差降低了11%-28%。对于空间令牌，学习到的图-视觉变化耦合相比向每个令牌广播相同的平均图运动上下文具有更低的误差，尤其是当图像中非相邻部位在空间上接近时更为显著。在真实机器人倒立摆序列上，JointGV将DINO-WM的32步摆杆角度误差从12.56°降低至6.69°，同时也改善了DreamerV3和LeWorldModel的性能。在仿真倒立摆控制中，使用JointGV校正后的滚动预测训练的智能体完成了50个回合中的46个，而使用原始滚动预测训练的智能体则未能完成任何回合。

Authors: Tian Lyu, Yichen Jiang, Ziyuan Cheng, Yunda Yan, Xiangyu Pan, Junjie Jiang, Jialin Yu, Boyu Ning, Pietro Liò, Fan Mo

Progress Predicts Policy Manipulation

progress field world model behavioral cloning manipulation imitation learning

简要说明：PPP通过学习语言条件标量进度场，并借助共享世界模型从梯度推导出混合策略，在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中优于行为克隆方法。

TLDR: PPP learns a language-conditioned scalar progress field for robot manipulation, deriving a hybrid policy from its gradient via a shared world model, and outperforms behavioral cloning in simulated and real robot experiments.

Abstract: A task specifies how the world should change, while a policy specifies what the robot should do. We introduce Progress Predicts Policy (PPP), which learns a language-conditioned scalar field through the commands induced by its differential. We obtain action conditioning by composing a latent progress field with a shared world model and read its action gradient at a fixed reference command. Continuous commands scale this gradient by a learned positive gain, while discrete commands use finite differences of the same scalar. This yields a hybrid policy without a separate action head or iterative search. Fitting demonstration progress values alone does not ensure that action gradients align with expert commands. PPP trains the induced commands by imitation and uses double backpropagation for the continuous gradient readout to shape the field's local control geometry. Demonstration timing calibrates field values on observed states without additional annotation. The continuous readout remains learnable without progress labels but these timing-derived targets support progress monitoring during execution. Experiments in simulated and real robot manipulation show that PPP outperforms behavioral cloning under a shared architecture.

摘要（中文）：一项任务规定了世界应如何改变，而一项策略则规定了机器人应做什么。我们提出了“进展预测策略”（PPP），该方法通过其微分所引发的指令来学习一个语言条件下的标量场。我们通过将一个潜在进展场与共享世界模型组合来实现动作条件化，并在固定参考指令下读取其动作梯度。连续指令通过习得的正增益缩放该梯度，而离散指令则使用同一标量的有限差分。这产生了一种无需独立动作头或迭代搜索的混合策略。仅拟合演示进展值并不能确保动作梯度与专家指令对齐。PPP通过模仿训练所引发的指令，并利用双反向传播进行连续梯度读取，以塑造该场的局部控制几何结构。演示时序在不需额外标注的情况下校准观测状态上的场值。连续读取在没有进展标签的情况下仍可学习，但这些时序派生目标支持执行过程中的进展监控。在仿真和真实机器人操作实验表明，在共享架构下，PPP优于行为克隆方法。

Authors: Licheng Zhong, Gim Hee Lee

Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid running reinforcement learning vision-based lane perception thermal management real-world deployment

简要说明：本文介绍了一个部署在Unitree G1上的完整自主人形机器人赛跑系统，该系统集成了基于视觉的车道感知、基于强化学习的跑步策略和热管理，以实现可靠的实世界性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a complete autonomous humanoid running system deployed on the Unitree G1 at the World Humanoid Robot Games, integrating vision-based lane perception, RL-based running policies, and thermal management for reliable real-world performance.

Abstract: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的方法现已使仿人机器人能够稳健奔跑，并开始参与竞技体育赛事。然而，鲜有研究报告描述在实际比赛中完整自主运行的仿人机器人系统，这要求机器人在新场地沿赛道行进、在硬件限制内调整配速，并在无干预的情况下完成比赛。我们报告了这样一套系统，部署于商用人形机器人Unitree G1上，参加了2026年世界仿人机器人运动会100米、400米和1500米项目。该系统集成了基于视觉的赛道感知、路径跟踪，以及通过强化学习并结合人体运动先验训练而成的奔跑策略。为应对仿人机器人奔跑中的挑战，我们稳定了头部相机图像以抵消身体运动，并利用IMU辅助的腿部里程计跨越腾空阶段。为管理电机发热，我们在训练过程中对髋关节俯仰力矩施加惩罚，加装散热板，并根据温度实施限速，同时结合项目特异的配速策略。该机器人在100米项目中于74支队伍中排名第13，400米第一轮于44支队伍中获得第10名，随后在半决赛中摔倒，1500米项目在35支队伍中位居第7。在此次部署中，热裕度决定了每场比赛的配速，而半决赛的摔倒源于赛道检测错误。

Authors: Koki Inami, Takashi Sato, Hiroyuki Oka, Shota Takizawa, Yuya Takahashi, Amon Suzuki, Hayato Ono, Kohtaro Ihara, Yuki Noka, Shohei Matsugu

CoBoVLA: Decoupling Language from Action with Discrete Codes for Robust and Interpretable Robot Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action Discrete codes Instruction robustness Real-time control Failure diagnosis

简要说明：CoBoVLA 提出了一种 250M 参数的 VLA 模型，通过离散可解释码将语言理解与动作生成解耦，从而提高了对指令改写的鲁棒性，并实现了 LIBERO 基准上的失败诊断。

TLDR: CoBoVLA introduces a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding from action generation via discrete interpretable codes, improving robustness to instruction paraphrasing and enabling failure diagnosis on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve high success rates on the LIBERO benchmark but remain sensitive to paraphrasing. Existing VLAs ranging from 0.6B to 7.5B parameters experience a 22-52 point performance drop on LIBERO-Para while SmolVLA exhibits an even larger decline, from 83\% to 8\%. Because most VLAs jointly learn language understanding and action generation, it is difficult to determine whether a failure originates from misunderstanding an instruction or executing it incorrectly. To address these challenges, we introduce CoBoVLA, or CodeBookVLA, a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding, planning, and control through learned discrete interpretable codes. A text encoder maps the instructions to shared step codes, which a visual planner then converts into action code sequences executed by a language-independent actor. This design improves robustness to instruction paraphrasing while allowing failures to be traced to individual stages. It also enables efficient real-time control on resource-constrained hardware by encoding instructions only once and using compact discrete representations to keep each component lightweight. CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency. On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases. Without two-step demonstrations, CoBoVLA completes 48.8\% of 160 free-form two-step tasks. Finally, success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures. Together, these results demonstrate that decoupling language understanding and control can improve instruction robustness while making VLA failures easier to diagnose.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在LIBERO基准上取得了较高的成功率，但对指令改写（paraphrasing）仍表现出较高敏感性。现有参数规模从0.6B到7.5B不等的VLA模型，在LIBERO-Para上的性能下降幅度为22至52个百分点，而SmolVLA的下降更为显著，从83%骤降至8%。由于大多数VLA模型将语言理解与动作生成联合学习，因此难以判断某一失败究竟源于对指令的误解还是执行错误。为解决这些问题，我们提出了CoBoVLA（CodeBookVLA），一个参数量为250M的VLA模型，通过学习得到的离散可解释编码（codes）将语言理解、规划与控制三个阶段解耦。文本编码器将指令映射为共享的步骤编码，随后视觉规划器将其转换为由语言无关的执行器执行的动作编码序列。该设计在提升对指令改写鲁棒性的同时，使失败能够被追溯至具体阶段。此外，该设计通过仅对指令编码一次，并利用紧凑的离散表示保持各组件的轻量化，从而在资源受限的硬件上实现高效的实时控制。在匹配协议下，CoBoVLA在LIBERO-Goal上达到91.4%的成功率，而SmolVLA为82.8%，单步控制延迟为17毫秒。在LIBERO-Para上，CoBoVLA在4,092条未见改写指令上达到81.1%的成功率，在匹配片段上达到78.5%，而经LoRA在改写数据上微调的SmolVLA仅为36.5%。在没有两步演示的情况下，CoBoVLA在160个自由形式的两步任务中完成48.8%。此外，当指令被正确编码时成功率可达91%，而编码错误时则降至27.2%，这表明语言理解是剩余失败的主要来源。综合以上结果，将语言理解与控制解耦，不仅能提升指令鲁棒性，还能使VLA模型的失败更易于诊断。

Authors: Mehul Arora, Dhruv Agarwal, Ambuj Agrawal

AutoE2E: Don't speak - Language free end-to-end autonomy A Real-Time Driving Model for L2++ ADAS and L4 Robotaxis AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving temporal bird's-eye-view trajectory prediction open-source real-vehicle

简要说明：AutoE2E 提出了一种开源、无语言端到端驾驶模型，采用时间鸟瞰图架构和循环轨迹规划器，在 KITScenes 上报告了开环结果，并进行了初步实车测试。

TLDR: AutoE2E presents an open-source, language-free end-to-end driving model with a temporal BEV architecture and recurrent trajectory planner, reporting open-loop results on KITScenes and preliminary real-vehicle tests.

Abstract: AutoE2E is an open-source end-to-end driving model developed by the Autoware Foundation Robotaxi Working Group. It introduces a temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) architecture that combines multi-camera perception, HD-map information and route conditioning to predict future vehicle motion. The evaluated model uses a pretrained camera-BEV backbone, temporal feature fusion and a lightweight recurrent trajectory planner. It contains approximately 79.9 million parameters, of which approximately 1.45 million are trainable in the evaluated configuration. The v1.0 release provides model checkpoints, training and evaluation code, and DataModelConsole, a dashboard for visualizing and inspecting model experiments. On the KITScenes validation benchmark, the fine-tuned checkpoint achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 0.745 m and a final displacement error (FDE) of 2.020 m at a three-second prediction horizon. The paper also reports preliminary real-vehicle research conducted with the Technical University of Munich's EDGAR platform, alongside ongoing collaboration with the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. AutoE2E v1.0 is an early open research release. Its quantitative evaluation is open-loop, and the model has not yet demonstrated validated closed-loop autonomous driving. The release is intended to provide the autonomous-driving community with an inspectable baseline for further research, experimentation and collaborative development.

摘要（中文）：AutoE2E是由Autoware基金会Robotaxi工作组开发的开源端到端驾驶模型。该模型引入了一种时间鸟瞰图（BEV）架构，结合多摄像头感知、高清地图信息和路线条件来预测未来车辆运动。评估模型采用预训练的摄像头-BEV骨干网络、时间特征融合和轻量级循环轨迹规划器。模型包含约7990万个参数，其中在评估配置下约145万个参数可训练。v1.0版本提供模型检查点、训练和评估代码，以及DataModelConsole——一个用于可视化和检查模型实验的仪表板。在KITScenes验证基准上，微调后的检查点在3秒预测时域内实现了0.745米的平均位移误差（ADE）和2.020米的最终位移误差（FDE）。论文还报告了与慕尼黑工业大学EDGAR平台开展的初步实车研究，以及与卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院的持续合作。AutoE2E v1.0是早期开放研究版本，其定量评估为开环评估，模型尚未展示经过验证的闭环自动驾驶能力。该版本的发布旨在为自动驾驶社区提供一个可检查的基线，以支持进一步研究、实验和协作开发。

Authors: Muhammad Zain Khawaja, Zaynab El Mawas, Ryota Yamada, Gabriela Cordova, Arseni Lysak, Intisar Chowdhury, Bharat Jayaprakash, Apostolos Georgiadis, Shri Harsha Adapala, Jatin Gautam, Christoph Bank, Alejandra Solarte Uscategui, Atanasko Boris Mitrev, Hassan Ali Ansari, Nishad Sahu

SR-VLA: Stall-Reduced VLA Execution via Predicted-Input Lookahead and Selective KV Cache Repair VLA

Vision-Language-Action Speculative Execution KV Cache Repair Latency Hiding LIBERO

简要说明：SR-VLA 通过预测未来输入预先计算 KV 缓存和动作块，并选择性修复缓存以减少 VLA 策略的推理停滞，在 LIBERO 基准上实现显著查询加速。

TLDR: SR-VLA introduces a stall-reduction mechanism for VLA policies by predicting future inputs to precompute KV caches and action chunks, with selective cache repair to handle prediction errors, achieving significant query speedups on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur control stalls when inference blocks the next action chunk. Asynchronous early inference can hide latency, but its results may be inconsistent with the arriving actual inputs. Unconditional reuse risks acting on mismatched inputs, whereas full recomputation discards useful precomputation. We propose SR-VLA, combining predicted-input lookahead with selective KV cache repair. During current chunk execution, a lightweight action-conditioned predictor generates next-boundary visual observations and proprioceptive state. These predictions, together with the task instruction, drive the frozen VLA to precompute a speculative KV cache and action chunk. After real inputs are available to VLA, predicted--real differences and task conditions determine whether to accept the action chunk or trigger selective KV repair. On LIBERO, SR-VLA achieves $2.67\times$ and $1.27\times$ query speedups over the respective synchronous $π_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA-OFT baselines, while maintaining competitive average task success rates. Under target-motion perturbation, success remains baseline-comparable, with $1.52\times$--$1.93\times$ query speedup.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在推理阻塞下一动作片段时会产生控制停顿。异步早期推理可以隐藏延迟，但其结果可能与实际到达的输入不一致。无条件复用存在基于不匹配输入执行动作的风险，而完全重计算则会丢弃有用的预计算结果。我们提出SR-VLA，将预测输入前瞻与选择性KV缓存修复相结合。在当前动作片段执行期间，一个轻量级的动作条件预测器生成下一边界的视觉观测和本体感知状态。这些预测连同任务指令一起，驱动冻结的VLA预计算推测性KV缓存和动作片段。当真实输入可供VLA使用后，预测与真实之间的差异以及任务条件决定是接受该动作片段还是触发选择性KV修复。在LIBERO上，SR-VLA相较于同步的$π_{0.5}$和OpenVLA-OFT基线分别实现了$2.67\times$和$1.27\times$的查询加速，同时保持了具有竞争力的平均任务成功率。在目标运动扰动下，成功率保持与基线相当，查询加速为$1.52\times$--$1.93\times$。

Authors: Tao Zhang, Yi Zhong, Jinhao Ruan, Yipeng Gao, Linfeng Zhong, Youming Yang, Yuan Wang

FIRE-Drive: Feasibility-Informed Risk Evaluation for End-to-End Diffusion Planning AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving diffusion planning feasibility-informed risk evaluation bird's-eye-view risk evidence closed-loop evaluation

简要说明：FIRE-Drive提出了一种面向扩散式端到端自动驾驶的可行性风险评估框架，通过改进轨迹初始化、风险感知评分和监督机制，提升了NAVSIM和Bench2Drive上的规划性能。

TLDR: FIRE-Drive introduces a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework for diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving, enhancing trajectory initialization, risk-aware scoring, and supervision to improve planning performance on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive.

Abstract: Diffusion-based end-to-end autonomous driving models have shown strong potential in generating multimodal planning trajectories. However, their performance still depends heavily on trajectory initialization, mode evaluation, and supervision quality. Weakly constrained noisy initialization may introduce infeasible proposals and increase the burden of denoising. Moreover, selecting the optimal mode remains challenging when candidate trajectories are geometrically similar but differ in safety, interaction risk, and progress. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-Drive, a feasibility-informed risk evaluation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving. FIRE-Drive improves diffusion-based planning through dynamic feasible anchor initialization, candidate-specific bird's-eye-view risk evidence, and compact high-quality candidate supervision with lightweight refinement. This design aligns the initial support, risk-aware scoring, and multimodal supervision of trajectory modes under a unified planning objective. It enables the diffusion decoder to focus on refining plausible trajectories while the scorer distinguishes modes using local risk evidence. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 show that FIRE-Drive achieves a Predictive Driver Model Score of 91.5 with a ResNet34 backbone. Additional closed-loop evaluation on 220 Bench2Drive routes yields a Driving Score of 71.43 and a Success Rate of 42.73%. Component ablations and a scorer comparison under matched candidate inputs support the contributions of feasible initialization, auxiliary supervision, and risk-informed selection. Our code is available at https://github.com/Latte00/FIRE-drive.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的端到端自动驾驶模型在生成多模态规划轨迹方面展现出强大潜力。然而，其性能仍高度依赖于轨迹初始化、模式评估和监督质量。弱约束的噪声初始化可能引入不可行的候选轨迹，并增加去噪负担。此外，当候选轨迹在几何上相似但在安全性、交互风险和进展方面存在差异时，选择最优模式仍具挑战性。为解决上述问题，我们提出FIRE-Drive，一种面向端到端自动驾驶的可行性感知风险评估框架。FIRE-Drive通过动态可行锚点初始化、候选特定的鸟瞰图风险证据，以及轻量级细化下的紧凑高质量候选监督，提升了基于扩散的规划性能。该设计在统一的规划目标下，将轨迹模式的初始支持、风险感知评分和多模态监督对齐。它使扩散解码器能够专注于细化合理轨迹，同时评分器利用局部风险证据区分不同模式。在NAVSIM v1上的实验表明，FIRE-Drive在ResNet34骨干网络下取得了91.5的预测驾驶员模型得分。此外，在220条Bench2Drive路线上的闭环评估中，驾驶得分为71.43，成功率为42.73%。在匹配候选输入下的组件消融实验和评分器对比验证了可行初始化、辅助监督和风险感知选择的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Latte00/FIRE-drive获取。

Authors: Qifeng Xie, Kai-Yuan Feng, Wenkang Wan, Yue Wu, Maoguo Gong, Kai Sheng

From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion Locomotion

thermal-aware locomotion reinforcement learning quadruped robot temperature prediction Unitree Go2

简要说明：本文提出一种热感知四足运动强化学习策略，通过预测并最小化电机温度渐近值，将四足机器人的持续运动从热关机限制转为电池限制。

TLDR: This paper introduces a thermally aware reinforcement learning policy for quadruped locomotion that predicts and minimizes motor temperature asymptotes, extending operation time from thermal shutdown to battery depletion on a Unitree Go2.

Abstract: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

摘要（中文）：在腿式机器人中，持续运动往往以热关机而非电池耗尽告终：行走产生的热量集中在少数关节电机上，这些电机在电池耗尽前很久便已过热。我们在不观测温度的情况下，通过强化学习训练了具有热感知能力的运动策略，并在Unitree Go2四足机器人上进行了验证。我们首先构建了一个耦合的13节点集总RC热网络模型，该模型基于单台机器人的两次运行数据拟合，并根据实测电功率进行校准，能够在不同机器人个体、步态、负载和速度下，以低于1°C的平均均方根误差预测全部十二个电机的温度。在持续步态下，电机最终达到的稳态温度直接由步态平均的力矩平方和关节速度决定。我们的核心贡献在于设计了一种奖励机制，用于降低预测的最高渐近温度：热时间常数比强化学习的信用分配时间尺度大若干个数量级，但预测渐近温度在一个步态周期内即可对力矩和关节速度作出响应，因此策略无需温度输入即可学会降低热量并使其分散。在实物机器人上，该策略将持续运动从受温度限制转变为受电池限制：在携带5 kg负载、速度为1 m/s的条件下，学习基线在19分钟（1.1 km）后达到热关机，而我们的策略在26°C环境中运行174分钟（10.0 km），直至电池耗尽，且其最高温度电机比关机阈值低14°C；在包含楼梯和坡道的无负载工厂测试路线上，基线在25圈（6.2 km）后过热，而我们的策略在单次电池电量下完成了47圈（11.2 km），并留有22°C的余量。
