Authors: Xianyao Li, Ruitong Tian, Rui Min, Fang Xu, Jing Du

When the World Is the Test Suite: Agentic Intelligence for the Physical World Other

agentic intelligence physical world program testing robot policies continuous integration

简要说明：本文综述了物理世界代理智能这一新兴领域，其中AI代理为机器人和物理系统编写程序，并提议将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，探讨了程序的编写、测试和学习方式，最终倡导建立一种物理世界的持续集成验证方法。

TLDR: This paper surveys the emerging area of agentic intelligence for the physical world, where AI agents write programs for robots and physical systems, and proposes treating the world as the test suite, examining how these programs are written, tested, and learned from, ultimately advocating for a physical counterpart to continuous integration for verification.

Abstract: Coding agents built to repair software now write, test, and repair programs for robots, laboratories, and industrial controllers. Unlike in software engineering, no test suite comes with the code. Whether a program works must be established by running it on a robot, in a physics simulator, or through the policies it helps to train, and such evidence is costly to obtain and can itself be wrong. As these agents take on more physical tasks, how their programs are judged matters as much as how they are written. This paper examines this emerging area, agentic intelligence for the physical world, by treating the world as the program's test suite. We organize the discussion around three questions: how agents write programs for the physical world, how these programs are tested, and how agents learn from the results. We first trace how language models for robots and software engineering agents came together, ask which software testing practices carry over to physical tests, and describe each program by where it sits relative to the actuator and by what judges it. For writing, we cover programs that act as robot policies and programs that support policy learning by producing rewards, tasks, and training worlds. For testing, we examine what physical trials cost, what traces, learned judges, simulators, and formal checks can establish in their place, and what safety requires beyond task success. For learning, we discuss how tested programs are retained as experience, in skill libraries and in model weights. Finally, we turn to benchmarks and evaluation practice and outline open challenges. Writing programs is becoming cheap, while trustworthy evidence about what they do remains costly. Progress will therefore depend on a physical counterpart of continuous integration: verification cheap enough to run often, reliable enough to trust under search, and maintained alongside the experience it validates.

摘要（中文）：专为软件修复而构建的编码智能体，如今已能编写、测试并修复用于机器人、实验室及工业控制器的程序。与软件工程不同，这些代码并不附带测试套件。程序能否正常运行，必须通过在机器人上运行、在物理模拟器中测试，或通过其协助训练的策略来加以验证，而这类证据的获取成本高昂，且其本身也可能存在错误。随着这些智能体承担越来越多的物理任务，其程序的评判方式与编写方式同等重要。本文通过将物理世界视为程序的测试套件，审视了这一新兴领域——面向物理世界的智能体智能。我们围绕三个问题组织讨论：智能体如何为物理世界编写程序，这些程序如何被测试，以及智能体如何从结果中学习。我们首先追溯了面向机器人的语言模型与软件工程智能体是如何融合的，探讨了哪些软件测试实践可迁移至物理测试，并根据程序相对于执行器的位置及其评判者，对每类程序进行了描述。在编写方面，我们涵盖了充当机器人策略的程序，以及通过生成奖励、任务和训练环境来支持策略学习的程序。在测试方面，我们考察了物理试验的成本，以及轨迹数据、学习型评判者、模拟器和形式化检查能替代物理试验确立何种结论，并探讨了安全要求超越任务成功之外的方面。在学习方面，我们讨论了经过测试的程序如何作为经验被保留，存储于技能库和模型权重之中。最后，我们转向基准测试与评估实践，并概述了尚待解决的挑战。编写程序正变得日益廉价，而关于程序行为之可信证据的获取依然代价高昂。因此，进展将依赖于物理世界对应物般的持续集成机制：一种廉价到足以频繁运行、可靠到足以在搜索中信任，并与其所验证的经验同步维护的验证方式。

Authors: Kaixin Li, Meng Luo, Yanlin Li, Yuchen Tian, Xiang Liu, Xiangru Jian, Yan Yang, Zhiheng Xi, Yang Zhang, Ziyang Luo, Mingfei Cheng, Hongzhan Lin

ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body motion tracking human avoidance pretrained tracking policies humanoid teleoperation

简要说明：ALERT 提出了一种轻量级通用管线，为人形全身跟踪策略添加人类感知与主动避让能力，实现在人机共享空间中的无碰撞执行，并保持原有跟踪性能。

TLDR: ALERT introduces a lightweight, general pipeline that equips pretrained humanoid whole-body tracking policies with human perception and proactive avoidance for collision-free operation in shared spaces, preserving tracking performance across diverse backbones.

Abstract: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.

摘要（中文）：全身运动追踪技术已实现了人形机器人舞蹈、运动动作及远程操作，为能力展示与操作数据采集奠定了基础。然而，现有追踪策略缺乏对附近人类的感知和主动避让能力，而动作替代与基于局部约束的修正方式可能损害参考动作的完整性和追踪连续性。我们提出了ALERT，一种通用的轻量级流水线，用于将运动追踪扩展至人机共享环境。通过轻量化适配，该框架将人类感知与主动避让整合进预训练追踪策略中，在避让需求与参考动作追踪之间实现平衡，同时保留现有运动能力。跨追踪骨干网络的仿真与真实世界实验表明，该方法通过局部化的人类避让实现了可靠的免碰撞执行，保持了全身协调性，并能快速恢复参考动作追踪，同时保留了预训练策略追踪未见动作的能力。

Authors: Zhaoyang Li, Chiyu Zhang, Chengxin Xu, Peng Yang, Zhonghao Guo, Wanting Li, Ziyu Chen

DailyBrick: Language-Guided Synthesis of Brick Assembly Instructions Manipulation

agentic system brick-by-brick assembly robot assembly LLM construction verification

简要说明：DailyBrick 是一个多阶段智能体系统，利用 LLM 生成 LEGO 模型及逐步组装说明，并通过 Meta-Reviewer 代理验证，展示了在机器人操纵组装中的实用性。

TLDR: DailyBrick is a multi-stage agentic system that uses LLMs to generate LEGO models with brick-by-brick assembly instructions, verified by a Meta-Reviewer agent, and demonstrates utility in robot manipulation for assembly.

Abstract: Generating a LEGO model from a user request is more than a plausible 3D shape generation. LEGO models require physical support per brick, and each brick should be placed unblocked. Current methods address this issue by training an expert large language model. We reduce the problem of generating extremely long context on all brick connections to that of writing a program that builds LEGO models like a human, considering each intermediate step could be executed. We introduce DailyBrick , a multi-stage agentic system that produces a LEGO model together with a brick-by-brick assembly instruction for human building and robot assembly. We design a multi-stage harness with roles to help LLMs generate more effectively. A versioned construction SDK compiles multi-level decisions, from semantic subparts to individual bricks, into canonical operations. An external Meta-Reviewer agent replays and inspects the generated package, verifies the model and its construction process, identifies failures, traces them to the responsible stage, and routes them to bounded repairs or to editable candidates for later skill or tool updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DailyBrick generates LEGO models based on simple user requests better than recent agentic systems, and show its utility in downstream applications such as robot manipulations on model assembly from instructions and brick sets (https://SpatialAgent.github.io/DailyBrick/).

摘要（中文）：根据用户请求生成乐高模型不仅仅是生成一个合理的3D形状。乐高模型要求每块积木都能获得物理支撑，并且每块积木都应无遮挡地放置。现有方法通过训练专家级大语言模型来解决这一问题。我们将生成所有积木连接关系的超长上下文问题，简化为编写一个像人类一样构建乐高模型的程序，并考虑每个中间步骤都可执行。我们提出了DailyBrick，一个多阶段智能体系统，它能够生成乐高模型，同时提供逐块拼装的装配说明，供人类搭建和机器人组装使用。我们设计了一个多阶段框架并赋予各阶段不同角色，以帮助大语言模型更高效地生成内容。一个版本化的构建SDK将多级决策——从语义子部件到单个积木——编译为规范化操作。一个外部元评审智能体对整个生成包进行回放和检查，验证模型及其构建过程，识别故障，追踪故障来源至相应阶段，并将其引导至有界修复或可供后续技能/工具更新的可编辑候选项。大量实验表明，DailyBrick在基于简单用户请求生成乐高模型方面优于近期智能体系统，并展示了其在从说明和积木套装中进行模型组装的机器人操控等下游应用中的实用性（https://SpatialAgent.github.io/DailyBrick/）。

Authors: Hang Zhang, Qijian Tian, Yuan Xie, Xuhong Wang, Xin Tan

Low-speed Limit Cycle Walking of Planar X-shaped Bipedal Robot with Special Properties Locomotion

X-shaped bipedal robot limit cycle walking semicircular foot gait generation collision

简要说明：本文提出一种具有特殊质量分布的平面半圆足X形双足机器人，并展示了通过设计的控制器生成稳定极限环步态的方法，证明了碰撞前后摆动腿角速度不变及稳态步态中控制输入时间积分为零等特殊性质，并通过数值仿真验证了理论结果。

TLDR: This paper presents a planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot with special mass distribution, and shows how to generate a stable limit cycle gait with a designed controller, proving several unique properties such as unchanged swing-leg angular velocity at collision and zero time-integral control input in steady gait, verified by numerical simulations.

Abstract: This paper proposes a novel planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot in which the center of mass of each leg link is at the same position as the hip joint, and discusses a method for generating a stable limit cycle gait on level ground. First, we outline the assumptions of the robot model with four degrees of freedom, and develop the mathematical equations of motion and collision. Second, we set the relative hip-joint angle as a control output and design a control system to follow it to the desired trajectory specified as a fifth-order function of time. Third, we mathematically show that there are special properties: the angular velocity of the swing leg does not change before and after the collision, and the time-integral of the control input becomes zero in a steady gait. We also mathematically show that the model has the feature that approximate linearization is effective and the antigravity effect of semicircular feet can be utilized. Through numerical simulations, we verify the validity of the theoretical results, and analyze some fundamental gait properties such as convergence speed and mechanical energy restoration.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种新颖的平面半圆足X型双足机器人，其每条腿连杆的质心与髋关节位于同一位置，并探讨了在水平地面上生成稳定极限环步态的方法。首先，我们概述了具有四个自由度的机器人模型的假设，并建立了运动方程和碰撞方程的数学表达式。其次，我们将相对髋关节角设定为控制输出，并设计了一个控制系统，使其跟踪一条以时间为自变量的五次函数形式的目标轨迹。第三，我们从数学上证明了若干特殊性质：摆动腿在碰撞前后的角速度不变，且在稳定步态中控制输入的时间积分为零。我们还从数学上证明了该模型具有近似线性化有效的特性，并能利用半圆足的抗重力效应。通过数值仿真，我们验证了理论结果的有效性，并分析了收敛速度、机械能恢复等基本步态特性。

Authors: Fumihiko Asano, Cong Yan

VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models AutonomousDriving

vehicle attribute classification motion trajectory powertrain CAN signals cross-model generalization

简要说明：该论文提出了VTT，一个从运动轨迹和CAN信号中跨未见车型分类车辆尺寸和动力总成类型的数据集和基准，在动力总成分类上取得了高准确率，并探讨了跨模型泛化问题。

TLDR: The paper introduces VTT, a dataset and benchmark for classifying vehicle size and powertrain type from motion and CAN signals across unseen car models, achieving high accuracy for powertrain classification and providing insights into cross-model generalization.

Abstract: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.

摘要（中文）：车辆尺寸和动力系统信息可以丰富用于交通分析和仿真的轨迹数据。我们提出了VTT，一个用于从未见过的汽车模型中通过运动信号和控制器区域网络（CAN）信号识别这些属性的数据集和基准。该数据集包含来自1,431辆汽车和174种车型的9,062次行驶记录，总计约3,950小时。它提供了三种基于足迹的尺寸类别、动力系统标签，并评估了在未见车型和未见驾驶员上的表现。使用60秒窗口，我们比较了四种序列架构、统计特征以及由大型语言模型提出的物理特征。通过辅助物理目标训练、数据增强和任务特定加权，纯电动汽车与燃油车的驾驶级宏F1分数提升至92.6-93.0%，尺寸分类的宏F1分数从62.9%提升至67.1%。在来自额外4,061名驾驶员的公开日志上，全输入模型在88种车型中正确识别了86种车型的动力系统；尺寸分类准确率为63.2%，接近内部车型级结果63.5%。物理特征分析将动力系统识别与减速行为相关联，将尺寸识别与转向响应相关联。尺寸类别边界附近的误差以及更长观测时间带来的有限增益，凸显了标签分辨率和训练车队覆盖范围对跨车型泛化的重要性。

Authors: Yuhang Wang, Yuechen Guo, Jingxin Yang, Chuheng Wei, Suyang Chen, Abdulaziz Alhuraish, Yiyi Wang, Mingyang Ban, Jingran Sun, Hao Zhou

SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping Locomotion

multi-LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry legged robot adaptive downsampling plane bundle adjustment incremental pose graph

简要说明：SE(3)-LIVOM 提出了一种自适应多激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计与建图系统，在 IROS 2026 的 COMFORT 挑战赛中获得冠军，在多种复杂环境中为腿式机器人实现了厘米级的轨迹精度。

TLDR: SE(3)-LIVOM presents an adaptive multi-LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry and mapping system that won the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026, achieving centimeter-level trajectory accuracy on a legged robot in diverse challenging environments.

Abstract: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了SE(3)-LIVOM系统，该系统在IROS 2026 COMFORT挑战赛中荣获总冠军。该挑战要求生成GrandTour数据集中腿式机器人的轨迹，场景包括坍塌建筑、施工场地和雪地。SE(3)-LIVOM利用两个激光雷达、一个相机和一个惯性测量单元实时运行。其前端将SE(3)-LIO扩展至多激光雷达和相机配置，自适应降采样使得各场景内及跨场景的单次扫描处理时间保持在约35毫秒。在线后端通过子地图平面光束法平差和增量位姿图校正漂移。系统在统一配置下，于六个测试场景中达到了平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）1.40厘米的精度。代码已开源，见https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort。

Authors: Gunhee Shin, Seungjae Lee, Daebeom Kim, Seoyeon Jang, Hyun Myung

Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor AutonomousDriving

weight-space programming large language models tractor guidance neural controller closed-loop control

简要说明：本文提出了权重空间编程，让大语言模型直接修改拖拉机导航控制器的神经网络权重，无需梯度下降即可实现真实世界的转向控制。

TLDR: This paper introduces weight-space programming, where LLMs directly edit neural network weights for a tractor guidance controller, achieving real-world steering without gradient descent.

Abstract: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. Both models read the network and analysed the closed loop with control theory correctly, and Fable's repair without simulation succeeded only occasionally. With simulated feedback, both models repaired the trained network in single sessions and wrote a working controller from zero weights, whereas from zero the evolution strategy found none. The controllers written from zero were sparse and in a classical cascaded structure; one model edited the trained network while the other replaced it. Gradient descent reached higher accuracy with far more simulation, and all language model controllers steered the real tractor without intervention, with errors of the same order as pure pursuit. Language models can program the weights of a neural controller directly, much as control engineers design one. We call this Weight-Space Engineering.

摘要（中文）：权重空间编程是一种过程，其中大型语言模型直接读取和写入神经网络的权重，根据自然语言规范进行引导，无需优化器或梯度下降。本研究将其应用于自动拖拉机导航，其中包含253个参数的神经网络沿直线和弧线路径转向，并需在机器变化时进行调整，例如转向执行器变慢的情况。GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1（以及5.2）利用少量模拟评估预算，为我们的研究拖拉机编辑网络，修复为另一台拖拉机训练的网络，并将控制器写入权重为零的网络中。我们将它们与进化策略、梯度下降和纯追踪在仿真及真实拖拉机上进行了比较。两个模型均正确读取了网络，并用控制理论分析了闭环，而Fable在无模拟情况下的修复仅偶尔成功。借助模拟反馈，两个模型均在单次会话中修复了训练好的网络，并从零权重编写了可工作的控制器，而进化策略从零开始则未能找到任何控制器。从零编写的控制器结构稀疏，采用经典级联结构；一个模型编辑了训练好的网络，而另一个模型则替换了它。梯度下降以多得多的模拟达到了更高的精度，且所有语言模型控制器均无需干预即可操控真实拖拉机，误差与纯追踪处于同一量级。语言模型可以直接编程神经控制器的权重，如同控制工程师设计控制器一样。我们称此为“权重空间工程”。

Authors: Timo Oksanen

HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning Other

egocentric video robot learning IMU imitation learning dataset

简要说明：HubEgo-100K 是一个大规模的真实工作场所第一人称视频数据集，旨在提高机器人学习数据的多样性，支持模仿学习的泛化。

TLDR: HubEgo-100K is a large-scale egocentric video dataset of skilled work in real workplaces, designed to improve the diversity of robot learning data and support imitation learning generalization.

Abstract: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

摘要（中文）：通过模仿训练的机器人策略，在训练环境与物体之外的情境中泛化能力较差。已发表的数据扩展研究表明，泛化能力随训练环境和物体多样性的增加而提升，而非依赖于每个环境中的更多演示次数。跨多个环境收集机器人数据成本高昂，而在现实世界中大规模记录以自我为中心的人类视频则是可行的；然而，现有以自我为中心的视频大多展示日常生活中的活动，较少包含真实工作场景中的熟练操作。我们提出了HubEgo-100K，一个为多样性而构建的数据集。本版本论文涵盖首次发布v1.0：包含10,124小时的1080p自我中心视频，以及来自单台头戴式手机摄像头的同步100 Hz惯性测量单元数据。在v1.0中，12,227名贡献者记录了他们在15,548个环境中的即兴工作（每个贡献者拥有自己所属的一类环境，如厨房或车间），覆盖11种环境类型、30个工作类别、56种任务类型和35种动作族，其中83%的时长为工作场景视频。该数据集包含72,754个片段，附有机器生成的动作和语言标注，以LeRobot和MCAP格式提供，并遵循CC BY 4.0许可协议。我们沿各维度衡量了多样性，表明在v1.0中，即使片段为随机顺序，新的贡献者和词汇仍不断出现，并将这些测量结果与已发表的关于六种与策略性能相关的数据属性的证据进行了关联，包括手部可见性和惯性感知。我们还记录了数据收集、整理、隐私保护措施和数据格式，并提供了数据表。后续版本的论文将添加基准测试，并逐步扩展至100,000小时的数据发布。

Authors: Javad Amirian, Armin Kiani, Loïc Schaeffer, Tim Sprecher, Mohamed Taha, Karthik Yadati

Agile Monoped Hopping on Complex and Discrete Terrain via Kinodynamic Planning with Distilled MPPI Steering Locomotion

kinodynamic planning RRT MPPI conditional flow matching monoped hopping

简要说明：FlowRRT 是一种用于离散地形上敏捷单足跳跃的动力学规划器，利用条件流匹配将多起点 MPPI 专家蒸馏为生成式集合值转向采样器，从而发现非贪婪机动，并以远短于基线的时间实现高成功率。

TLDR: FlowRRT is a kinodynamic RRT planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain, using conditional flow matching to distill a multi-start MPPI expert into a generative set-valued steering sampler that discovers non-greedy maneuvers and achieves high success rates with much shorter planning times than baselines.

Abstract: This paper presents FlowRRT, a kinodynamic planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain. Steering for kinodynamic RRT on complex dynamical systems currently relies on motion primitives or closed-loop policies, limiting the diversity of motions or the planning speed. Distilling a trajectory optimizer avoids both, but existing methods regress a single solution per query, which fails on monoped hopping, where the feasible action set is narrow and disconnected. Our key insight is to treat steering as set-valued and predict the distribution of feasible actions instead. A multi-start MPPI expert collects the entire feasible set of each query offline, and conditional flow matching distills it into a generative sampler. With this sampler, FlowRRT coordinates successive jumps over long horizons and finds non-greedy maneuvers that are hard for reactive policies to discover. Benchmarks across different terrains show higher success rates and substantially shorter planning times than sampling-based baselines. On terrains with inclined platforms, FlowRRT reaches $80\%$ success within $1$~s, versus $24$~s for RL-RRT and $77$~s for SST. Sim-to-sim tracking in MuJoCo confirms accurate execution under full-order dynamics.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了FlowRRT，一种针对离散地形上敏捷单足跳跃的动力学运动规划器。在复杂动力学系统上，运动学RRT的引导目前依赖于运动基元或闭环策略，这限制了运动的多样性或规划速度。通过蒸馏轨迹优化器可以避免上述两种限制，但现有方法对每个查询只回归单一解，这在单足跳跃中难以奏效，因为其可行动作集狭窄且不连通。我们的关键洞察在于将引导视为集值问题，转而预测可行动作的分布。一种多起点MPPI专家算法离线收集每个查询的完整可行集，条件流匹配将其蒸馏为一个生成式采样器。借助该采样器，FlowRRT能够在长时域内协调连续的跳跃，并发现反应式策略难以找到的非贪心机动动作。在不同地形上的基准测试表明，与基于采样的基线方法相比，FlowRRT具有更高的成功率和显著更短的规划时间。在包含倾斜平台的地形上，FlowRRT在1秒内达到80%的成功率，而RL-RRT需要24秒，SST需要77秒。在MuJoCo中的仿真到仿真跟踪验证了在全阶动力学下的精确执行。

Authors: Yue Qin, Denglin Cheng, Jingyu Liu, Yanran Ding

A Probabilistic Lateral Motion Prediction Model with Improved Response Fidelity for Vehicle-in-the-Loop Simulation AutonomousDriving

lateral motion prediction vehicle-in-the-loop simulation recurrent neural network probabilistic residual learning multistep rollout training

简要说明：本文提出一种用于车辆在环仿真的概率侧向运动预测模型，结合二自由度车辆模型物理先验与循环神经网络残差校正及多步展开训练，提高了侧向响应保真度和集成运动预测精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model for vehicle-in-the-loop simulation, combining a 2-DOF vehicle model as a physical prior with a recurrent neural network for residual corrections and multistep rollout training, improving lateral response fidelity and integrated motion prediction.

Abstract: Vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) simulation requires a lateral dynamics model that accurately reproduces vehicle responses and reliably generates horizontal lateral-position and heading commands through recursive integration. This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model with improved response fidelity. A two-degree-of-freedom vehicle model provides the physical prior, while a recurrent neural network learns correlated residual corrections to lateral acceleration and yaw rate. To maintain prediction fidelity during recursive motion generation, multistep rollout training feeds corrected responses into subsequent states and histories and directly penalizes accumulated lateral-velocity error. A conditional Gaussian characterizes response uncertainty, which is propagated to lateral-response, position, and heading predictions through augmented-state linearization. Evaluation results demonstrate improved lateral-response and integrated-motion prediction. Compared with the Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation, the proposed model reduces mean lateral-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.596 m to 0.483 m, an improvement of 19.0%, while reducing mean lateral-velocity RMSE from 0.0469 m/s to 0.0441 m/s. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors, probabilistic residual learning, and multistep rollout training for response-faithful lateral motion prediction.

摘要（中文）：车辆在环（VIL）仿真需要一种侧向动力学模型，该模型能够准确复现车辆响应，并通过递推积分可靠地生成水平侧向位置和航向指令。本文提出了一种具有改进响应保真度的概率侧向运动预测模型。两自由度车辆模型提供物理先验，而循环神经网络则学习侧向加速度和横摆角速度的相关残差修正。为了在递推运动生成过程中保持预测保真度，多步展开训练将修正后的响应馈入后续状态和历史信息中，并直接惩罚累积的侧向速度误差。条件高斯分布刻画了响应不确定性，并通过增广状态线性化将其传播到侧向响应、位置和航向预测中。评估结果表明，该模型在侧向响应和集成运动预测方面均有改进。与深度动力学侧向自适应方法相比，所提出的模型将平均侧向位置均方根误差（RMSE）从0.596 m降至0.483 m，提升了19.0%，同时将平均侧向速度RMSE从0.0469 m/s降至0.0441 m/s。这些结果证明了将物理先验、概率残差学习与多步展开训练相结合，对于实现响应保真侧向运动预测的有效性。

Authors: Xiangyang Ye, Chaosheng Huang, Jinwen Yang, Zhengxian Chen, Jun Li

GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR Perception3D

hybrid solid-state LiDAR geometric segmentation ground segmentation road segmentation real-time

简要说明：GHySSeg 是一种纯几何、实时的混合固态 LiDAR 地面和道路分割方法，无需训练或 GPU，并在新基准 HySoLiD-Drive 上优于基线。

TLDR: GHySSeg is a purely geometric, real-time method for ground and road segmentation on hybrid solid-state LiDAR, requiring no training or GPU, and outperforms baselines on a new benchmark HySoLiD-Drive.

Abstract: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.

摘要（中文）：混合固态激光雷达传感器正逐步应用于量产车辆，然而其生成的数据在结构上与当前自动驾驶数据集背后成熟旋转机械传感器所生成的数据存在差异：混合固态数据无环状结构、密度高、杂乱，且集中于前向视场。自动驾驶车辆在可行驶空间计算与导航中所依赖的经典几何方法，均假设数据具有360度旋转激光雷达的有序环列结构，因此在此类数据上性能下降甚至失效；而基于学习的方法则计算负担重、难以认证，且几乎仅在旋转激光雷达数据上训练。我们证明，这种密集的逐曲线几何结构恰恰是弥合业界偏好传感器与自动驾驶研究之间鸿沟的契机。我们提出GHySSeg，一种纯几何方法，通过追踪每条扫描曲线并读取两种几何特征——高度阶跃与距离回折——对单帧混合固态激光雷达数据进行地面与可行驶道路分割，无需训练，亦无需图形处理器。为进行评估，我们发布了HySoLiD-Drive，首个专用于车载混合固态激光雷达的地面与道路分割公开基准，包含两辆真实行驶车辆记录的100帧人工标注数据及7000帧未标注数据。在该基准上，GHySSeg在地面与道路分割任务中均超越了几何方法与基于学习的最先进基线，道路分割交并比达到0.907，地面分割交并比达到0.896，精确率超过0.96，同时在单核上以约每帧22毫秒的速度实时运行。

Authors: Martín Palos, Fernando García

Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models WorldModel

video world models panoramic evolution latent diffusion view synthesis world state

简要说明：PanoEvo 提出了一种全景世界状态演化机制，用于视频世界模型，使场景在视角变化时保持一致演化，并通过透视渲染器生成清晰视图，在多个世界模型基准上取得了最优结果。

TLDR: PanoEvo introduces a panoramic world state evolution mechanism for video world models, enabling consistent scene evolution across viewpoint changes and rendering sharp views via a perspective renderer, achieving state-of-the-art results on world model benchmarks.

Abstract: Video world models should maintain a world that keeps evolving as the viewpoint changes. Yet when the camera turns away and returns, current models often freeze the unobserved scene, lose objects, or change their appearance, because content outside the view has no representation that keeps changing. We present PanoEvo, which uses a Panoramic Evolver to evolve the world state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model, where every viewing direction is present at every time step, so the scene evolves whether or not it is observed. Existing panoramic video models are not trained to evolve a scene from a single image or the objects within it, so we build PanoEvo-Data, an event-centric dataset from real 360° videos, and train the Panoramic Evolver coarse-to-fine as an image-to-panoramic-video model. Since each view covers only a small part of the low-resolution panorama, directly projected views are blurry and often show low-quality details or structural errors. A Perspective Renderer, built on a perspective video diffusion model, reads this state via latent-space projection and direction-restricted cross-attention to render sharp, high-quality views. PanoEvo achieves the best overall score among 23 publicly evaluated models on WRBench and the highest total score on STEVO-Bench. Code, models, and data will be released.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型应维持一个随视角变化而持续演进的世界。然而，当摄像头移开再返回时，现有模型常常冻结未观测场景、丢失物体或改变其外观，原因在于视野外的内容缺乏持续变化的表征。我们提出PanoEvo，利用全景演化器在全景视频扩散模型的潜空间中演化世界状态，在该空间中每个时刻所有视角方向均存在，因此无论场景是否被观测，它都能持续演化。现有的全景视频模型并未被训练为从单张图像或其内部物体演化场景，因此我们构建了PanoEvo-Data，一个基于真实360°视频的事件中心数据集，并将全景演化器由粗到细地训练为图像到全景视频的模型。由于每个视图仅覆盖低分辨率全景的一小部分，直接投影的视图往往模糊不清，且常呈现低质量细节或结构错误。基于透视视频扩散模型构建的透视渲染器通过潜空间投影和方向受限的交叉注意力读取该状态，以渲染清晰、高质量的视图。PanoEvo在WRBench的23个公开评测模型中取得最佳综合得分，并在STEVO-Bench上获得最高总分。代码、模型和数据将予以公开。

Authors: Longtao Jiang, Mingfei Han, Jianmin Bao, Tingjun Dai, Jinjie Wei, Zhiran Zhang, Xin Tao, Zhihui Li, Salman Khan, Xiaojun Chang

CascadeJEPA: Enhancing 3D Geometric Representations via Spatially Coupled Cascaded Prediction WorldModel

Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture 3D geometric representation cascaded prediction world model planning feature forecasting

简要说明：CascadeJEPA通过全网格上下文和级联预测增强JEPA模型的3D几何表示，改善几何任务和世界模型规划，同时保持语义性能。

TLDR: CascadeJEPA enhances 3D geometric representations in JEPA-based models by cascading predictions across full-grid contexts, improving geometric tasks and world model planning while preserving semantic performance.

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for predictive visual representation learning. However, our analysis of I-JEPA reveals a growing discrepancy between semantic and geometric learning: improved semantic recognition during pretraining is accompanied by degraded 3D geometric representations. We hypothesize that this partly stems from predicting highly abstract latent representations with incomplete spatial context, favoring semantic regularities over fine-grained geometric information. To address this issue, we introduce CascadeJEPA, a spatially coupled cascaded prediction framework that promotes richer patch-level interactions through full-grid context encoding and cross-attention between prediction stages, while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over I-JEPA across multiple 3D geometric tasks while maintaining strong semantic recognition performance. Furthermore, its advantages extend to future feature forecasting and world model planning, highlighting the potential of enhanced geometric representations to support predictive world modeling.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）已成为预测式视觉表示学习的一种重要范式。然而，我们对I-JEPA的分析揭示了语义学习与几何学习之间日益增长的差异：预训练过程中语义识别能力的提升伴随着三维几何表示能力的退化。我们推测，这一现象部分源于在不完整的空间上下文条件下预测高度抽象的潜在表示，从而偏向于语义规律而非细粒度的几何信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CascadeJEPA，一种空间耦合的级联预测框架，通过全网格上下文编码和预测阶段间的交叉注意力促进更丰富的补丁级交互，同时基本保留原有I-JEPA架构。大量实验表明，该方法在多项三维几何任务上相较于I-JEPA取得了显著提升，同时保持了较强的语义识别性能。此外，其优势还扩展至未来特征预测和世界模型规划，凸显了增强的几何表示在支持预测式世界建模方面的潜力。

Authors: Kailai Zhou, Ziqi Chen, Xiaoning Xu, Yuefeng Wu, Zixuan Fu, Zijun Lin, Zhihao Li, Youwei Pang, Xiaoqi Zhao, Xun Cao, Bihan Wen

Pressure Drop: Gravity Vector Estimation from a Distributed Barometric Pressure Sensor Array Other

gravity vector estimation barometric pressure sensor tilt estimation SLAM ICP

简要说明：本文提出了一种利用分布式气压传感器阵列估计重力向量的新方法，在静态场景下倾斜估计的中位误差为0.87°，其性能与基于IMU的方法相当，并展示了在机器人SLAM和ICP算法中的应用潜力。

TLDR: The paper introduces a novel method for estimating the gravity vector using a distributed array of barometric pressure sensors, achieving tilt estimation accuracy comparable to IMU-based methods, with potential applications in robotic SLAM and ICP algorithms.

Abstract: While gravity is often used in mobile robotics as a global constraint for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms, most estimation methods rely on indirect observation of the gravity vector. In this paper, we propose the use of altimeter measurements to directly observe the direction of the gravity vector. We provide a theoretical evaluation of the estimation noise and validate it through extensive experimental data, along with an evaluation of the impact of intersensor distance on our gravity vector estimates. Experimental results demonstrate that a median error of $0.87^\circ$ on the tilt estimation can be achieved with our system in semi-static scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of this approach by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods based on Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). We highlight that we achieve similar performance to that of IMU-based systems in highly dynamic scenarios and even outperform in specific cases of accelerometer measurement saturation. Finally, an additional experiment shows the potential use within a robotic system through the integration into an Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm.

摘要（中文）：虽然重力常被用作移动机器人同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）算法中的全局约束，但大多数估计方法依赖于对重力矢量的间接观测。本文提出利用高度计测量值来直接观测重力矢量的方向。我们给出了估计噪声的理论评估，并通过大量实验数据对其进行了验证，同时评估了传感器间距对我们重力矢量估计的影响。实验结果表明，在半静态场景下，我们的系统在倾斜估计上可实现中位误差为$0.87^\circ$的精度。此外，我们通过与基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的最先进方法进行比较，展示了该方法的潜力。我们强调，在高度动态场景中，我们的系统能达到与基于IMU的系统相当的性能，甚至在加速度计测量饱和的特定情况下表现更优。最后，一项附加实验展示了该方法在机器人系统中的潜在应用，即通过集成到迭代最近点（ICP）算法中实现。

Authors: William Dubois, Nicolas Lauzon, Johann Laconte, François Pomerleau

Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Robust Synthesis of Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Other

Signal Temporal Logic SMT synthesis transition system long horizon

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于SMT的STL规格合成方法，相比最先进的MILP方法，在长时间范围任务上扩展性更好且能更快适应环境变化。该方法将STL和转换系统编码为SMT约束，并通过实验证明了其在长时域任务上的优势。

TLDR: This paper introduces an SMT-based synthesis method for Signal Temporal Logic specifications, which scales better for long time horizons and adapts more quickly to environmental changes compared to the state-of-the-art MILP-based approach. The method encodes STL and transition systems into SMT constraints and empirically demonstrates improved performance on long-horizon tasks.

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic is a popular framework for describing a robotic system's goals. Once described using a temporal logic framework, synthesis turns the goals into actual steps for the robots to follow. Currently, the state of the art for sound and complete synthesis is using Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), which struggles on long time horizons and large environments, preventing the construction of guaranteed safe plans for long deployments. This paper introduces a new synthesis method using Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) which scales better for long deployments and adapts to environmental changes more quickly. We do this by introducing an encoding method for STL into SMT constraints, and an encoding method for discrete-time dynamical systems modeled as a transition system. We then conduct an empirical comparison of our SMT based methods against the state of the art MILP based methods. Results show that for this class of problems, SMT is an effective encoding strategy that performs the best on long time horizon tasks.

摘要（中文）：信号时序逻辑是一种用于描述机器人系统目标的常用框架。一旦使用时序逻辑框架进行描述，综合过程便会将这些目标转化为机器人实际执行的步骤。目前，实现完备且可靠综合的最先进方法是使用混合整数线性规划（MILP），但该方法在长时间跨度和大规模环境中表现不佳，从而阻碍了为长期部署构建有安全保障计划的能力。本文提出了一种基于可满足性模理论（SMT）的新型综合方法，该方法在长期部署中具有更好的可扩展性，并能更快地适应环境变化。为此，我们引入了一种将STL编码为SMT约束的方法，以及一种针对建模为转移系统的离散时间动力学系统的编码方法。随后，我们将基于SMT的方法与基于MILP的最先进方法进行了实证比较。结果表明，对于此类问题，SMT是一种有效的编码策略，在长时间跨度任务中表现最佳。

Authors: Philip Smith, Kevin Leahy

Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions Other

forest simulator robotic autonomy parametric trees satellite-informed synthetic data

简要说明：Arboreus 是一个数据驱动的北方森林仿真器，用于生成逼真的合成森林环境，以测试和验证机器人自主算法。它利用卫星数据生成树木分布、地形数据生成地形，并支持多种物理引擎进行机器人测试。

TLDR: Arboreus is a data-informed Boreal forest simulator for generating realistic synthetic forest environments, aimed at benchmarking and validating robotic autonomy algorithms. It uses satellite data for tree distribution, topographic data for terrain, and supports multiple physics engines for robot testing.

Abstract: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.

摘要（中文）：本工作介绍了Arboreus，一种逼真的北方森林模拟器，旨在支持北方森林环境中机器人自主算法的统计验证。Arboreus提出了一种自动化方法，可从参数化树木、高度变化地形及卫星信息驱动的树木密度分布中，合成大规模、数据支撑且形态合理的森林世界。主要北方树种（如桦树、云杉和松树）的参数化生成，依据北欧地区生长研究中提取的树干、树冠及枝叶参数进行指导。感兴趣区域内的树木分布由Copernicus卫星数据集引导，该数据集提供高达10米栅格分辨率的树冠覆盖密度及优势树种类型。森林地表生成受瑞典地籍局的地形数据引导，以产生具有数据支撑的真实地形。给定感兴趣森林区域的坐标与范围，Arboreus可合成数据支撑且形态合理的森林，同时提供灵活性以注入用户对真实森林的观测数据（细节、林龄、尺寸维度和树木数量），这对于生成真实的合成数据以及测试对特征敏感的自主算法至关重要。Arboreus在Gazebosim、Unreal Engine和Isaac Sim物理引擎中展示了其在不同机器人移动平台自主性基准测试与验证中的适用性。同时，也展示了Arboreus作为合成森林数据源的潜力，以及其对下游森林资源测绘研究（如材积估算、单木实例分割和树干属性估计）的支持能力。Arboreus已开源，并附带一个包含25个面积为1000平方米、对应三个真实林区的北方森林世界的数据集。

Authors: F. Labra Caso, A. Saradagi, A. Koval, G. Nikolakopoulos

Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments Manipulation

mobile manipulator industrial robot Mecanum drive Hector SLAM object detection

简要说明：本技术报告介绍了Auriga Robotics为工业环境设计的移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，集成了麦克纳姆轮底盘、五自由度机械臂以及基于NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX的感知与导航模块（Hector SLAM、A*、YOLO）。

TLDR: This technical report describes the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot for industrial environments, integrating a Mecanum-drive base, a 5-DOF arm, and perception/navigation modules (Hector SLAM, A*, YOLO) on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX.

Abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了Auriga Robotics公司移动机械臂机器人的设计与实现，该机器人由沙希德·贝赫什提大学电气工程系机器人及智能自动化实验室开发，以下将该平台简称为@Work机器人。该机器人面向工业任务，重点在于提升重复性或危险工作环境中的作业效率。其采用四轮麦克纳姆轮驱动实现全向移动，并配备具有五个自由度的机械臂及3D打印夹爪，用于物体抓取与导航操作。电子系统由基于ESP32微控制器的定制PCB板构成，并搭载英伟达Jetson Orin NX模块负责高层处理与实时系统控制。软件方面，Hector SLAM用于建图与定位，A*算法用于路径规划，YOLO用于实时目标检测。各模块基于融合传感器数据，实现稳健的导航与可靠的碰撞规避。总体而言，该系统展现了良好的软硬件集成能力，在面向工业化场景的自主导航、物体抓取及任务执行中均表现出稳定一致的性能。

Authors: Aria Dadnavi, Matin Jamshidi, Kian Khatibi, Shahriar Karimi Makhsous, Saina Najafi Shabestari, Seyed Sobhan Hosseini Hajibekandeh, Zahra Mahaam, Reyhane Mohasseli, Ghazal Ghoreishi, Amirhossein Gholizadeh Behbahani, Mohammad Hossein Moaiyeri

Pelorus: Resource-Aware Lidar-Inertial Odometry Perception3D

lidar-inertial odometry resource-aware fixed-capacity map multiresolution GPU offloading

简要说明：Pelorus 是一种资源感知的激光雷达-惯性里程计系统，通过固定容量的多分辨率地图和 CPU/GPU 并行处理来限制内存使用，在嵌入式硬件上实现低位姿误差和实时性能。

TLDR: Pelorus is a resource-aware lidar-inertial odometry system that bounds memory usage with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map and parallel CPU/GPU processing, achieving low pose error and real-time performance on embedded hardware.

Abstract: Lidar-inertial odometry (LIO) has an efficiency problem. High-resolution lidars produce millions of points per second that must be processed online on the resource-constrained hardware of robots, cars, or drones, yet most LIO methods neither bound their memory nor report their compute footprint. We introduce Pelorus, a resource-aware LIO with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map of voxelized normal distributions and an iterated equivariant state estimator. A relevance-based eviction keeps the map memory bounded, and a maturity-weighted map update suppresses inconsistent observations. The pipeline runs in parallel on CPUs and GPUs. On five sequences from three public datasets, Pelorus achieves the lowest relative pose error in seven of ten metrics with a small, bounded memory footprint and, with GPU offloading, the lowest CPU load of all compared methods. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, it processes a 128-beam lidar at 10 Hz. Pelorus is open source with CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal backends.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）存在效率问题。高分辨率激光雷达每秒产生数百万个点，必须在机器人、汽车或无人机等资源受限的硬件上在线处理，然而大多数LIO方法既未限制其内存使用，也未报告其计算开销。我们提出了Pelorus，一种资源感知型LIO，采用固定容量的多分辨率体素化正态分布地图，并配备迭代等变状态估计器。基于相关性的逐出机制保持地图内存有界，而基于成熟度的加权地图更新则抑制不一致的观测。该流程在CPU和GPU上并行运行。在来自三个公开数据集的五组序列上，Pelorus在十项指标中的七项上取得了最低的相对位姿误差，且内存占用小而受限；在GPU卸载的情况下，其CPU负载在所有对比方法中最低。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，它能够以10 Hz处理128线激光雷达数据。Pelorus是开源的，支持CUDA、Vulkan和Metal后端。

Authors: Charlotte Sieh, Mario Porrmann

Stochastic Diversity Windows: Diagnosing Noise Influence in Robotic Diffusion Sampling RLRobot

diffusion models robotics stochasticity sampling efficiency diagnostic

简要说明：本文提出了随机多样性窗口（SDWs），用于诊断机器人扩散策略中哪些去噪时间步对最终输出影响最大，并展示了针对这些窗口进行优化可在不牺牲性能的情况下将计算成本降低高达85%。

TLDR: This paper introduces stochastic diversity windows (SDWs), a diagnostic for identifying which denoising timesteps most influence final outputs of robotic diffusion policies, and demonstrates that targeting these windows can reduce computation by up to 85% without degrading performance.

Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly adopted in robotics and control due to their capability to express multiple feasible solutions to a given task. However, the role of stochasticity in the diffusion model-sampler across denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a per-timestep counterfactual diagnostic that tests how changing the sampled noise affects the final output. Across five model-sampler configurations spanning three robotics benchmarks, diverse architectures, domains, and conditioning mechanisms, we reveal highly varied temporal sensitivity profiles, where noise-induced deviations can amplify, partially contract, or undergo near-total attenuation downstream. From these profiles, we define stochastic diversity windows (SDWs): compact intervals that identify where sampler stochasticity has the strongest measured influence on the final output. Guided by these windows, we apply two heuristic interventions: targeted stochastic amplification, which increases sample diversity exploration of the solution space, and an SDW-hybrid sampler, which replaces DDPM steps with DDIM skips in low-impact regions, resulting in network evaluation reductions of up to 40-60% and wall-clock time by up to 85%, with no consistent changes detected in feasibility, cost, or diversity across held-out tasks.

摘要（中文）：扩散模型因其能够表达给定任务的多个可行解，近年来在机器人学和控制领域得到日益广泛的应用。然而，扩散模型采样器在去噪过程中随机性所发挥的作用仍未被充分理解。我们引入了一种逐时间步的反事实诊断方法，用于检验改变采样噪声如何影响最终输出。通过涵盖三个机器人基准测试、多种架构、领域及条件机制的五种模型-采样器配置，我们揭示了高度多变的时间敏感性特征，其中噪声引起的偏差在下游过程中可能被放大、部分收缩或近乎完全衰减。基于这些特征，我们定义了随机多样性窗口：即识别采样器随机性对最终输出影响最强的紧凑区间。在这些窗口的指导下，我们应用了两种启发式干预措施：靶向随机增强，以增加对解空间的样本多样性探索；以及一种基于随机多样性窗口的混合采样器，在低影响区域用确定性采样步骤替代扩散概率模型的随机步骤，从而将网络评估次数减少高达40–60%，实际运行时间减少最高达85%，而在保留任务中未检测到可行性、成本或多样性方面的一致变化。

Authors: Tina Lakhani, Jing Wu, Yu-Kun Lai, Ze Ji

Risk Density RRT$^*$: Planning in the Space of Probability Other

risk-aware planning RRT* planning under uncertainty collision probability sampling-based motion planning

简要说明：本文提出风险密度RRT*算法，将碰撞概率（风险）直接作为规划目标，通过可计算的风险密度泛函在存在不确定障碍物的环境中进行路径规划。

TLDR: This paper introduces Risk Density RRT*, a sampling-based planning algorithm that directly optimizes collision probability (risk) as the objective, supported by a tractable risk density functional for continuous paths in environments with uncertain obstacles.

Abstract: Planning under uncertainty is a fundamental problem in robotics. While much of the literature seeks minimum-cost paths subject to probabilistic constraints, this paper instead considers collision probability, or risk classically defined as probability times severity, directly as the planning objective. We propose Risk Density RRT$^*$ (RD-RRT$^*$), an extension of RRT$^*$ for high-level planning in environments with deterministic and uncertain obstacles. RD-RRT$^*$ builds on Risk Density, a functional that evaluates a continuous path as a whole and provides a tractable approximation of its collision probability. The framework also supports severity-weighted risk and a hybrid variant that adds a path-length penalty, balancing risk and geometric efficiency while regularizing exploration in low-density regions. We validate the method across a wide range of scenarios. The results show that RD-RRT$^*$ consistently finds paths with lower estimated collision probability by optimizing a global risk-based objective. We further demonstrate the fidelity of the underlying approximation through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we discuss how the topological structure induced by Risk Density may provide a useful representation of the environment and offer insights into risk-aware planning.

摘要（中文）：不确定性下的规划是机器人学中的一个基本问题。尽管大量文献关注在概率约束下寻求最小代价路径，本文则直接将碰撞概率——即经典定义中概率与严重性的乘积所构成的风险——作为规划目标。我们提出了风险密度RRT$^*$（RD-RRT$^*$），这是RRT$^*$的一种扩展，用于在包含确定性和不确定性障碍物的环境中进行高层规划。RD-RRT$^*$基于风险密度这一泛函，该泛函将连续路径作为整体进行评估，并对其碰撞概率提供可处理的近似。该框架还支持严重性加权风险，以及一种加入路径长度惩罚的混合变体，从而在风险与几何效率之间取得平衡，同时规范低密度区域中的探索行为。我们在广泛场景中验证了该方法。结果表明，RD-RRT$^*$通过优化基于全局风险的客观函数，始终能找到估计碰撞概率更低的路径。我们进一步通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了所提近似的保真度。最后，我们讨论了风险密度所诱导的拓扑结构如何为环境提供有用的表示，并为风险感知规划提供洞见。

Authors: Lorenzo Paiola, Giorgio Grioli, Antonio Bicchi

VLM-guided Grounding Expert for Generalised Referring Expression Comprehension Other

referring expression comprehension vision-language model grounding expert robotic manipulation joint attention

简要说明：本文提出了VGE，通过层间联合注意力和文本条件实例评分将冻结的VLM与可训练的接地专家相结合，在广义指代表达理解任务中取得领先性能，尤其在机器人场景下，并实现显著加速。

TLDR: The paper introduces VGE, a model combining a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert via layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring, achieving state-of-the-art generalized referring expression comprehension with significant speedups, particularly in robotic scenes.

Abstract: Generalised referring expression comprehension (GREC) aims to identify and localise the zero, one or multiple objects referred to by a language expression. In robotic manipulation, grounding also needs to remain accurate when requests for the same objects are paraphrased or embedded in additional context in robotics. However, grounding expert models are sensitive to instruction variation, while generative vision--language models (VLMs) struggle with complete target recovery and rejection of absent targets. These complementary limitations motivate combining the contextual representations of VLMs with the direct spatial prediction capabilities of grounding experts. We therefore introduce VLM-guided Grounding Expert (VGE), which combines a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert through layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring. These interfaces leverage multimodal understanding of the VLM to guide object-query refinement and candidate selection while retaining direct bounding-box prediction. Across three datasets, VGE achieves the highest averaged F1 score among the evaluated methods on all five test splits, with differences of at most 1.2 percentage points across instruction conditions within each split. On the dataset with robotic scenes, VGE also achieves the highest F1 across instruction variants and no-target, single-target and multiple-target cases. VGE provides a $5.3$--$13.0\times$ inference speedup over the baseline with the same VLM base model. These results support combining VLM context with specialised spatial prediction to address both grounding challenges, with particularly strong performance in robotic scenes. Code will be released upon publication.

摘要（中文）：广义指代表达理解（GREC）旨在识别并定位语言表达所指代的零个、一个或多个目标物体。在机器人操作中，当针对相同物体的请求以改写形式表达或嵌入了额外的上下文时，指代定位仍需保持准确。然而，指代定位专家模型对指令变化较为敏感，而生成式视觉-语言模型（VLM）则在完整目标恢复和拒绝不存在的目标方面存在困难。这些互补的局限促使我们将VLM的上下文表征与指代定位专家的直接空间预测能力相结合。为此，我们提出了VLM引导的指代定位专家模型（VGE），该模型通过分层联合注意力和文本条件实例评分，将冻结的VLM与可训练的指代定位专家相结合。这些交互接口利用VLM的多模态理解能力来引导对象查询的细化和候选选择，同时保留直接的边界框预测。在三个数据集上，VGE在所有五个测试划分中取得了评估方法中最高的平均F1分数，且每个划分内不同指令条件之间的差异最多为1.2个百分点。在包含机器人场景的数据集上，VGE在指令变体以及无目标、单目标和多目标情形下同样取得了最高的F1分数。与使用相同VLM基础模型的基线相比，VGE实现了$5.3$--$13.0\times$的推理加速。这些结果支持将VLM上下文与专门的空间预测相结合来解决指代定位中的两类挑战，且在机器人场景中表现尤为突出。代码将在论文发表后公开。

Authors: Mingcheng Zhu, Wentian Xu, Tao Lin, Shiying Duan, Ziyun Liang, Xuecheng Qi, Junyang Chen, Kuo Li, Zhifan Wan, Dong Wang, Richard Wang, Yang Gao

Where Do Human-to-Robot Transfer Gains Come From? VLA

Human-to-robot transfer HPT MetaWorld data subset size seed-level variability

简要说明：本文在MetaWorld上的HPT设置中研究了人-机器人迁移收益的来源，表明表面上的收益主要来自子集大小和训练变异性，而非任务知情的数据选择或机制预测。

TLDR: This paper investigates the sources of human-to-robot transfer gains in a human-robot transfer (HPT) setup on MetaWorld, showing that apparent gains largely stem from subset size and training variability rather than task-informed data selection or mechanistic predictions.

Abstract: Human data can support robot policy pretraining, but gains attributed to a data recipe may also reflect subset size, training variability, or downstream adaptation. In an HPT implementation on a 20-task MetaWorld suite with three training blocks, a constrained random 5,000-recording subset matches most of the task-informed subset's gain over the 40,000-recording pool at 20,000 updates (3.69 of 4.29 percentage points), leaving equal-size selection differences of 0.60 points at 5,000 recordings and 0.45 points at 1,250 recordings, with wide paired intervals. Across 12 comparisons, task orderings repeat across seeds for several contrasts, but a fixed predictor built from the other two seeds trails the mean or difficulty reference in at least one held-out fold for every comparison. Neither mechanism probe shows its predicted positive interaction: task-slot mismatch yields an interaction of $-0.0347$ points after adaptation, and in a six-task observation experiment the observation-by-pretraining interaction changes sign between seeds ($-18.29$ and $+1.04$ points) while full-state pretraining gains are positive in both ($+6.37$ and $+2.31$ points). This retrospective study shows how equal-size and capacity controls, seed-level reporting, and targeted interventions change the interpretation of apparent transfer gains.

摘要（中文）：人类数据可以支持机器人策略预训练，但归因于数据配方的性能提升也可能反映子集规模、训练变异性或下游适应等因素。在一个基于20任务MetaWorld套件、包含三个训练块的HPT实现中，一个受约束的随机5，000条记录子集在20，000次更新时，其相对于40，000条记录总池的性能提升大部分与基于任务信息的子集相当（4.29个百分点中的3.69个百分点），在5，000条记录时等规模选择差异为0.60个百分点，在1，250条记录时为0.45个百分点，且成对区间较宽。在12项比较中，多种对比的任务排序在不同随机种子间重复出现，但由另外两个种子构建的固定预测器在所有比较中至少在一个留出折上落后于均值或难度参考。两种机制探测均未显示出预期的正向交互作用：任务槽错配在适应后产生$-0.0347$个百分点的交互效应，而在一个六任务观察实验中，观察与预训练之间的交互效应在不同种子间改变了符号（$-18.29$和$+1.04$个百分点），而全状态预训练增益在两种情况下均为正（$+6.37$和$+2.31$个百分点）。这项回顾性研究表明，等规模与容量控制、种子级报告以及针对性干预如何改变对表面迁移增益的解释。

Authors: Jiachen Li, Shihao Li, Soovadeep Bakshi, Longteng Fan, Dongmei Chen, Long Chen, Zhuo Xu

TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception Other

multi-task learning underwater image enhancement depth estimation uncertainty estimation 3D robot visual perception

简要说明：TRIDENT是一个轻量级多任务学习模型，同时进行水下图像去雾、深度估计和不确定性估计，以高效且稳健的方式提升3D机器人视觉感知。

TLDR: TRIDENT is a lightweight multi-task learning model that simultaneously performs underwater image dehazing, depth estimation, and uncertainty estimation, improving 3D robotic visual perception with high efficiency and robustness.

Abstract: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home

摘要（中文）：水下视觉系统常因不可避免的光传播而遭受纹理模糊和色彩对比度低的问题。这些问题会显著降低稳定机器人操作的感知能力。本文提出了一种新颖的基于学习的传感系统，用于解决水下的多维视觉任务；具体而言，我们处理图像增强、深度估计以及面向三维视觉系统的不确定性。同时，我们提出了一种以快速且轻量方式实现的TRIDENT模型；TRIDENT由三个并行解码器和一个用于高效特征共享的主干结构组成。此外，该模型被设计为能够训练以表达复杂的参数化关系。在多个标准数据集的实验评估中，我们证明TRIDENT在图像增强和深度估计方面显著优于现有方法。尽管执行三项任务，我们的模型在内存大小和推理时间方面的效率均优于其他方法。最后，我们的联合学习方法在特征匹配方面展现出鲁棒性，并能无缝地从二维视觉任务扩展到三维视觉任务。补充材料可在https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home获取。

Authors: Geonmo Yang, Younggun Cho

Haptic Probing for Subsurface-Aware Force Distribution on Layered Soft Tissue Manipulation

haptic probing force distribution layered soft tissue dynamic admittance passivity

简要说明：本文提出一种触觉探测方法，在轻预载下通过短暂低幅激励区分皮下组织类型，并将该信息用于控制机械手上的力分布，以改善软组织的力跟踪和压力均匀性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a haptic probing method that uses a brief low-amplitude excitation under light preload to identify subsurface tissue type before force application, then uses this regime label to control force distribution across a robotic hand on layered soft tissue, improving force tracking and pressure uniformity on human subjects.

Abstract: Force-regulated contact with layered soft tissue fails most often where the subsurface composition changes: controllers infer the substrate from the loading signal alone, so the estimate guiding them lags the change---more acutely, we argue, over compliant than over bone-backed tissue. We remove that lag with a separate haptic channel. Under a light preload, a brief low-amplitude excitation lets the local dynamic admittance discriminate muscle from bone-backed tissue relative to a per-subject baseline, before task force is applied---active haptic sensing used to commit a control decision rather than to characterise tissue. A force- and tactile-driven distribution law then consumes that regime throughout execution: an instantaneous allocation equalises pressure across the engaged fingertips, while the regime sets the admissible pressure and hence the area the hand must recruit to deliver the target force---making patch area a controlled variable rather than a by-product. Probing, switches and recruitment are priced in a partitioned passivity budget, so safety monitoring cannot suppress the probe and a refused recruitment forfeits force tracking rather than the pressure bound. We report force tracking and pressure uniformity over curved, migrating contact on three human subjects, with regime labels from anatomical landmarks.

摘要（中文）：力控接触分层软组织时，失败最常发生在皮下组织成分发生变化的位置：控制器仅依赖加载信号推断基底特性，因此指导控制的估计值滞后于组织变化——我们认为，相较于骨支撑组织，在柔顺组织上这种滞后更为显著。我们通过独立的触觉通道消除该滞后。在轻预载条件下，短暂的低幅激励使局部动态导纳能够在施加任务力之前，相对每名受试者的基线区分肌肉与骨支撑组织——即利用主动触觉感知做出控制决策，而非表征组织特性。随后，基于力与触觉驱动的分配律在执行过程中持续应用该判别结果：瞬时分配使接触指尖间的压力均衡，而组织类型设定允许压力上限，从而决定手部为传递目标力所需征召的接触面积——使接触斑块面积成为受控变量而非副产物。探测、切换与征召过程在分区无源性预算内进行代价核算，因此安全监控不会抑制探测动作，而拒绝征召只会丧失力跟踪能力，而非突破压力边界。我们报告了三名受试者在弯曲、移动接触条件下的力跟踪与压力均匀性结果，组织类型标签以解剖标志为基准。

Authors: Lei Shi, Xiaoyu Wang, Cheng Zhou, Yongjian Liu, Jing Wang, Dongsheng Zhang, Yonghui Zhu, Xiong Li

CRA: Continuous Risk Assessment for Safety-critical Visual Navigation Other

continuous risk assessment visual navigation safety filter Poisson safety function LiDAR

简要说明：CRA从视觉和LiDAR数据中估计连续风险分数，并将其整合到安全过滤器中，用于开放世界机器人导航，并在模拟餐厅中进行了演示。

TLDR: CRA estimates continuous risk scores from visual and LiDAR data and integrates them into a safety filter for open-world robot navigation, demonstrated in a simulated restaurant.

Abstract: Traditional safety-critical control methods often rely on predefined constraints that separate states into safe and unsafe regions. While recent studies have extended geometric safety toward semantic safety, real-world safety is rarely purely binary. The risk associated with an object or human can vary continuously with its physical properties, like motion, and interaction context; for example, a person carrying a heavy object or a hot object moving at high speed may require a different safety response from an ordinary static obstacle. In this paper, we propose a vision-based continuous risk assessment framework for safety-critical visual navigation. Our method uses RGB and LiDAR observations to estimate four risk factors (kinetic, potential, contact-severity, and thermal) and combines them into a continuous risk score for each assessed object or person. These estimates are integrated into a Poisson safety function with a Laplace guidance field as a safety filter, enabling online monitoring and intervention in open-world robot navigation. We demonstrate the proposed method in a simulated restaurant scene.

摘要（中文）：传统安全关键控制方法往往依赖于将状态划分为安全与不安全区域的预定义约束。尽管近期研究已将几何安全拓展至语义安全，但现实世界中的安全极少是纯粹二元性的。物体或人员相关的风险会随其物理属性（如运动状态）及交互情境而连续变化；例如，携带重物或高温物体高速移动的人员，可能需要与普通静态障碍物不同的安全响应。本文提出了一种基于视觉的连续风险评估框架，用于安全关键的视觉导航。该方法利用RGB和激光雷达观测数据，评估四个风险因子（动能、势能、接触严重度和热风险），并将其组合为每个被评估物体或人员的连续风险评分。这些估计被整合到带有拉普拉斯引导场的泊松安全函数中，作为安全滤波器，实现在开放世界机器人导航中的在线监测与干预。我们在模拟餐厅场景中验证了所提方法。

Authors: Lihao Zheng, Ying Wu, Chen Jiang, Randy Freeman

ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy Other

ASV simulation NVIDIA Isaac Sim ROS 2 marine autonomy sim-to-real

简要说明：ASTRA 是一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 的自主水面艇模拟器，结合 Fossen 动力学、真实感感知和 ROS 2 接口，通过物理 BlueBoat 测试平台验证，支持仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: ASTRA is a marine ASV simulator built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines Fossen-style dynamics, photorealistic perception, and ROS 2 interfaces, verified against a physical BlueBoat testbed for sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.

摘要（中文）：自主水面车辆（ASVs）的自主性开发仍具挑战性，因为现场测试成本高昂且难以复现。现有的海洋仿真工具在船舶动力学、机器人集成和视觉渲染方面提供了成熟的能力，但这些优势在不同平台上的侧重各有不同。本文介绍了ASTRA——一个基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建的ASV仿真框架，它在同一环境中整合了船舶动力学、逼真感知以及机器人操作系统（ROS 2）自主性接口。ASTRA采用Fossen式海洋动力学模型，结合基于几何的浮力计算和可编程的谱波浪扰动，能够实现非平面静水及波浪诱导运动。该仿真器复现了物理BlueBoat测试平台的传感器配置，包括通过ROS 2暴露的GPS、IMU、LiDAR和RGB-D感知功能。这使得定位、感知、规划与控制软件的开发能够基于与物理平台一致的接口进行。BlueBoat现有的ROS 2定位与感知模块被直接移植到ASTRA中，同时通过针对性的零推进实验验证了所实现的波-体耦合。仿真中的横摇响应与预期中的非振荡静水特性一致，垂荡与生成的波浪场保持高度相干，在测试海况下主波频率处的增益约等于1。ASTRA旨在成为一个开源测试平台，用于海洋自主性开发、基于仿真的基准测试以及仿真到实物的实验研究。

Authors: Tsimafei Lazouski, Cody Sheltraw, Alan Papalia, Maani Ghaffari

Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring Other

Informative Path Planning Uncertainty Calibration Evidential Deep Learning Autonomous Surface Vehicles Oil Spill Monitoring

简要说明：本文研究了多水面无人艇油污监测信息路径规划中的不确定性校准问题，提出使用证据深度学习作为信息模型，在闭环规划中优于高斯过程和现有深度模型。

TLDR: This paper investigates uncertainty calibration in multi-vehicle informative path planning for oil spill monitoring with Autonomous Surface Vehicles, introducing Evidential Deep Learning as a calibration-aware information model that outperforms Gaussian Processes and other deep models in closed-loop planning.

Abstract: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.

摘要（中文）：利用自主水面航行器（ASVs）编队监测海上溢油，需要在严格的时间和能量预算约束下，根据稀疏且含噪声的测量数据绘制非均质污染物场分布图。信息路径规划（IPP）通过将推断场分布及其不确定性的重建模型与决定下一步采样位置的规划器相结合来应对这一挑战。以往研究主要聚焦于规划策略，并大多依赖高斯过程（GPs），对模型不确定性校准的探讨相对不足。本文研究了不确定性校准如何影响由共享不确定度图进行在线协调的ASVs编队进行多航行器IPP的性能。我们引入证据深度学习（EDL）作为一种不确定性校准的信息模型。在基于物理的溢油模拟环境中，我们将EDL、蒙特卡洛Dropout和深度集成与GP在闭环条件下进行对比，使用五种规划器进行基准测试。在60张地图上的实验结果表明，模型的选择对结果起主导作用，解释了最终重建误差方差的80%，而规划器在深度模型之间的方差贡献仅为1%。EDL在每种规划器下均取得最低误差和最高的IoU值，是最佳校准模型，且每步运行时间仅为3.9毫秒。在每台航行器分配50个采样单元的条件下，EDL的重建效果优于使用150个采样单元的MC Dropout和深度集成。深度集成在误差增大时置信度反而提高，而EDL不受此影响。因此，信息模型对其自身规划器采集的数据的鲁棒性是实现不确定性感知IPP的必要条件。

Authors: Alejandro Casado-Pérez, Marija Popović, Daniel Gutiérrez-Reina, Sergio L. Toral., Samuel Yanes

An Open-Source da Vinci X/Xi Instrument Module for Laparoscopic Surgery Research Manipulation

da Vinci instruments electrosurgery UR5 robotic arm open-source module laparoscopic surgery

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种开源硬件和软件模块，用于在UR5机械臂上控制达芬奇手术器械，实现腹腔镜电外科研究中的运动、视频和能量激活同步记录。

TLDR: This paper presents an open-source hardware and software module for controlling da Vinci surgical instruments on a UR5 robotic arm, enabling research in laparoscopic electrosurgery with synchronized motion, video, and energy activation recording.

Abstract: Studying electrosurgical tasks on a research robot requires control of both instrument motion and energy activation, along with a record of when each action occurs. This paper presents an open-source module for da Vinci X/Xi instruments on a UR5/UR5e robotic arm. Five motors transmit torque through timing belts to spring-loaded drive discs. An electrosurgical interposer accepts software commands, gives the surgeon's foot pedals priority, and records the source of each activation request. In bench testing, the interposer recorded all 12 activation and deactivation events from six pedal presses. Ex vivo demonstrations included monopolar and bipolar coagulation of splenic tissue and monopolar cutting during gallbladder dissection. Optical tracking of the Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps showed that calibration brought pitch and yaw gains from 0.904 and 1.14 to 1.00 and 1.02, respectively. The module enables researchers to record instrument motion, video, and the timing and source of electrosurgical commands during laparoscopic tasks.

摘要（中文）：研究机器人上开展电外科任务，需同时控制器械运动与能量激活，并记录各动作发生的时间。本文介绍一款开源模块，适用于UR5/UR5e机械臂上的达芬奇X/Xi器械。五个电机通过同步带将扭矩传递至弹簧加载的驱动盘。电外科转接器接收软件指令，优先响应外科医生脚踏板操作，并记录每次激活请求的来源。在台架测试中，该转接器准确记录了六次踏板按压产生的全部12次激活与去激活事件。体外演示包括脾脏组织的单极与双极凝血，以及胆囊 dissection 过程中的单极切割。对带窗双极抓钳的光学追踪显示，校准后俯仰与偏航增益分别由0.904和1.14提高至1.00和1.02。该模块使研究人员能够在腹腔镜任务中同步记录器械运动、视频以及电外科指令的时序与来源。

Authors: Douglas McDonough, Justin Liao, Jiawei Ge, Antony Goldenberg, Yvonne Zhang, Mackenzie A Eagleson, Ravi Prakash, Axel Krieger, Chunwoo Kim

Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models WorldModel

world models discrete diffusion data efficiency real-time inference gameplay generation

简要说明：本文提出了一种两阶段离散扩散方法，并引入轻量级精炼变换器，将自回归世界模型加速79倍，同时提高数据效率，仅需28小时的游戏数据即可训练。

TLDR: This paper introduces a two-stage discrete diffusion approach with a lightweight refinement transformer to speed up autoregressive world models by 79x while improving data efficiency, enabling training on only 28 hours of gameplay data.

Abstract: State-of-the-art world models have been used to produce sequences of gameplay that accord with provided user-input actions. However, high quality, consistent gameplay generation often comes at the cost of inference speed, making real-time interactive play and ideation challenging. The substantial quantities of data used to train state-of-the-art models have also made custom training of these models appear impractical, limiting many of their potential uses in creative fields. In this work we demonstrate a major step towards efficient world models: achieving both fast high-quality inference, and improved data efficiency. This is done by replacing the next-token prediction paradigm with a two-stage discrete diffusion-based approach, introducing a lightweight refinement transformer which carries out iterative masked predictions. Building on an autoregressive world model capable of generating highly consistent and complex sequences over minutes (Kanervisto et al., 2025), we achieve substantial model speed-up (79x) with a modest quality trade-off. Additionally, we demonstrate that this model can be trained to reproduce high-quality, consistent gameplay using a dataset containing approximately one day (28 hours) of gameplay data. Our results demonstrate progress towards removing barriers to the use of world models in settings where real-time inference and data efficiency are essential.

摘要（中文）：最先进的世界模型已被用于生成与所提供的用户输入动作相符的游戏玩法序列。然而，高质量且一致的游戏生成往往以推理速度为代价，这使得实时交互式游玩和构思面临挑战。用于训练最先进模型的大量数据也使得这些模型的定制训练显得不切实际，限制了其在创意领域的许多潜在应用。在本工作中，我们展示了迈向高效世界模型的重要一步：在实现快速高质量推理的同时，提升了数据效率。这一进展通过将下一标记预测范式替换为一种两阶段离散扩散方法来实现，并引入了一个轻量级细化变换器，用于执行迭代式掩码预测。基于一个能够生成持续数分钟高度一致且复杂序列的自回归世界模型（Kanervisto等，2025），我们实现了显著的模型加速（79倍），同时仅带来适度质量权衡。此外，我们证明了该模型可以使用包含约一天（28小时）游戏数据的数据集进行训练，从而再现高质量且一致的游戏玩法。我们的结果表明，在实时推理和数据效率至关重要的场景中，这项研究在消除世界模型应用障碍方面取得了进展。

Authors: Raluca Stevenson, David Bignell, Jennifer C. White, Tabish Rashid, Emanuele Aiello, Mariya Hendriksen, Junha Hyung, Sadegh Aliakbarian, Abdelhak Lemkhenter, Marko Tot, Katja Hofmann, Sarah Parisot

Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

safe in-context RL algorithm distillation budget-aware teacher adaptive Lagrange multiplier locomotion

简要说明：本文重新审视了安全算法蒸馏在安全上下文强化学习中的应用，提出了预算感知的两阶段教师和自适应拉格朗日乘子测试时调整（A-Lag），在五个安全RL基准上提高了回报并降低了代价。

TLDR: This paper revisits Safe Algorithm Distillation for safe in-context reinforcement learning, proposing a budget-aware two-phase teacher and an adaptive Lagrange multiplier test-time adjustment (A-Lag) to improve return and reduce cost across five safe RL benchmarks.

Abstract: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (Safe ICRL) asks a policy with fixed parameters to improve on an unseen constrained task from its interaction history while aiming to keep its cost within a budget. Prior work studied Safe ICRL on five benchmarks in three families: a grid world with a hidden goal and obstacles (DarkRoom), continuous navigation where goals and hazards stay invisible until reached (PointGoal, CarGoal), and locomotion with a hidden velocity limit (HalfCheetah, Ant). Safe Algorithm Distillation (Safe AD), trained on the learning histories of a safe RL algorithm, has shown adaptation failures in prior evaluations. For example, in the locomotion tasks its return stays below zero, and it rarely reaches the goal in CarGoal. We revisit two parts of Safe AD. First, we distill a budget-aware teacher with two phases. It searches for the hidden task, exploring more when more budget remains. After its first reward or cost, an expert policy exploits the task within the remaining budget. We collect the teacher's histories under fixed or dynamic budgets. Dynamic budgets increase the occupancy entropy of the return and budget inputs in every environment, and at test time they improve return and lower cost in DarkRoom and HalfCheetah. Second, we propose A-Lag, a test-time adjustment that reweights the distilled policy's actions by their predicted cost, with an adaptive Lagrange multiplier that is updated from the costs observed. In our experiments, A-Lag had lower mean episode cost than Safe AD in all five environments, with lower mean final return in four.

摘要（中文）：安全上下文强化学习（Safe ICRL）要求一个参数固定的策略仅凭其交互历史在未见过的约束任务上实现改进，同时力求将代价控制在预算之内。已有研究在三个族系的五个基准上考察了Safe ICRL：一个具有隐藏目标与障碍物的网格世界（DarkRoom）、目标与危险物在到达前不可见的连续导航任务（PointGoal、CarGoal），以及带有隐藏速度限制的运动任务（HalfCheetah、Ant）。安全算法蒸馏（Safe AD）在安全强化学习算法的学习历史上训练，在以往评估中表现出适应失败的问题。例如，在运动任务中其回报始终低于零，且在CarGoal中很少到达目标。我们重新审视了Safe AD的两个组成部分。首先，我们蒸馏一个两阶段、具有预算意识的教师模型。该模型搜索隐藏任务，在预算更充裕时探索更多。在获得首次奖励或代价后，由专家策略在剩余预算内利用该任务。我们在固定预算和动态预算两种条件下收集教师的历史数据。动态预算在所有环境中增加了回报与预算输入的占用熵，并且在测试时，在DarkRoom和HalfCheetah中提升了回报、降低了代价。其次，我们提出A-Lag，一种测试时调整方法，通过预测代价对蒸馏所得策略的动作重新加权，并采用从观测到的代价中更新的自适应拉格朗日乘子。在我们的实验中，A-Lag在所有五个环境中的平均回合代价均低于Safe AD，但在四个环境中的平均最终回报更低。
